description.en: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 据说在它出生的时候，背上就种有一个会和它身体一同成长的神奇种子。

description.en: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
description.zh_cn: 据说长在背上的花苞在吸收足够的养分后，就会开出大大的花朵。

description.en: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
description.zh_cn: 展开大片的花瓣沐浴阳光时，身体就会变得充满活力。

description.en: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
description.zh_cn: 尾巴上的火焰是小火龙生命力的象征。如果精神不错，火焰就会熊熊燃烧。

description.en: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
description.zh_cn: 会先挥舞尾巴扫倒对手，然后再用利爪将其撕成碎片。

description.en: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
description.zh_cn: 从嘴里吐出灼热的火焰时，尾巴尖端就会燃起更加鲜红炽烈的火焰。

description.en: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
description.zh_cn: 它会躲进甲壳里保护自己。会抓住对手的破绽，用喷水来反击。

description.en: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
description.zh_cn: 被“啪”地打到头的时候，它就会缩起身体躲进甲壳里。但是会露出一小段尾巴呢。

description.en: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
description.zh_cn: 身体很重，压住对手后就能让对手昏厥。遇到危险时会躲进壳里。

description.en: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.
description.zh_cn: 或许是想要尽快长大，它的食欲非常旺盛，每天能吃掉１００片叶子。

description.en: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.
description.zh_cn: 壳里面是黏糊糊的液体。为了准备迎接进化，正在不断地更新体内的细胞。

description.en: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.
description.zh_cn: 翅膀上覆盖着的鳞粉有剧毒。如果发现有鸟宝可梦要袭击绿毛虫，就会撒出鳞粉将它赶跑。

description.en: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
description.zh_cn: 大量栖息在森林或草地里。头顶上长着约５厘米的尖锐小毒针。

description.en: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
description.zh_cn: 虽然只靠自己几乎无法行动，但在遇到危险的时候，好像会让外壳变硬并以此来保护自己。

description.en: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
description.zh_cn: 会用双手及尾部的３根毒针刺击、刺击、不断地刺击对手。

description.en: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description.zh_cn: 大量分布在森林或树丛中。即使是在地上，有时也会用力拍打翅膀泼洒沙子。

description.en: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
description.zh_cn: 脚爪非常发达。会一把抓起猎物蛋蛋，带回１００公里外的巢穴。

description.en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
description.zh_cn: 觅食的时候，会贴着水面飞掠而过，抓起鲤鱼王等猎物。

description.en: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.
description.zh_cn: 门牙会终生生长。但要是长得太长，就会因无法进食而饿死。

description.en: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.
description.zh_cn: 据说会用后脚上小小的蹼泅水渡海，穿越岛屿来躲避敌人的追击。

description.en: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.
description.zh_cn: 生性鲁莽，只要是为了保护自己的领地，即便对手是大型宝可梦，也仍会冲向对手。

description.en: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
description.zh_cn: 在大嘴雀的领地上拿着食物走动可是相当危险的。食物转眼间就会被抢走。

description.en: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
description.zh_cn: 甚至可以通过让颚脱位来吞食比自己更大的猎物。进食后就会蜷缩起身体进行休息。

description.en: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
description.zh_cn: 根据最新的研究显示，它们腹部的花纹有着２０种以上不同的图案。

description.en: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
description.zh_cn: 有积存电力的特质。在皮卡丘群居的森林里会落雷不断，十分危险。

description.en: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.
description.zh_cn: 随着电力在体内的积聚，它会越发地具有攻击性。也有说法讲到其实电力就是它的压力。

description.en: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在雨量稀少的土地上。遇到危险就会蜷缩起身体，并以此来保护自己柔弱的腹部。

description.en: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.
description.zh_cn: 爪子和角经常会折断。折断的爪子和角会被制作成用来耕作土地的用具。

description.en: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description.zh_cn: 它体型虽小但有毒针，需要多加注意。雌性的角比较小。

description.en: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.
description.zh_cn: 由于是雌性，所以性情温和。嘴里发出的超音波有迷惑对手的力量。

description.en: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.
description.zh_cn: 会用长满鳞片的强壮身体堵住巢穴的入口，保护幼崽不被敌人攻击。

description.en: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
description.zh_cn: 会躲在草丛里只露出耳朵来探察周围的情况。能用有剧毒的角来保护自己。

description.en: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
description.zh_cn: 会竖起发达的耳朵探察周围的情况。一旦发现什么就会立刻扑过去。

description.en: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.
description.zh_cn: 像石头一样坚硬的皮肤以及长长的角是它的特征。角上有毒需要注意。

description.en: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.
description.zh_cn: 虽然深受人们的喜爱，但由于数量稀少故而十分珍贵。如果随便把它带出来炫耀，就会被小偷盯上哦。

description.en: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 连１公里外针落地的声音都能听到，所以它生活在鲜有人或宝可梦出入的深山里。

description.en: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.
description.zh_cn: 因漂亮的尾巴而深受人们喜爱。但是，如果不经常给其梳理毛发，很快就会变得全是毛球。

description.en: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.
description.zh_cn: 性格执拗，爱记仇。一旦遭到它的怨恨，它便会在１０００年间不断作祟，连对方的子孙都不放过。

description.en: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.
description.zh_cn: 可以在百货商店的寝具区买到收录有胖丁那神奇摇篮曲的ＣＤ。

description.en: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.
description.zh_cn: 富有弹性的身体和细腻的毛皮很受人们的喜爱。抱着它睡会感觉很惬意。

description.en: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
description.zh_cn: 因为没有眼珠，所以无法视物。会从口中发出超音波来探测周围的情况。

description.en: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 因为它肚子太饿而去咬了钢属性宝可梦，所以偶尔会看见缺了牙的大嘴蝠。

description.en: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
description.zh_cn: 白天会为躲避太阳而钻入凉爽的地下。会通过沐浴月光成长。

description.en: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
description.zh_cn: 奇臭无比！即使这样，１０００人中差不多仍有１人会喜欢闻这味道。

description.en: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description.zh_cn: 虽然花瓣越大，就能放出越多的花粉，但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。

description.en: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.
description.zh_cn: 可能是湿气不够，也可能是营养不足，反正阿罗拉的派拉斯背上的蘑菇都长得不怎么样。

description.en: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.
description.zh_cn: 底下的虫子基本上死了，真正的本体是背上的蘑菇。如果蘑菇掉下来，它就不会动了。

description.en: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
description.zh_cn: 大大的眼睛是由许多小眼睛汇聚在一起形成的。到了晚上会聚集在亮光下。

description.en: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
description.zh_cn: 碰到它播撒的鳞粉后，身体的感觉就会失常，变得无法笔直站立。

description.en: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.
description.zh_cn: 会在地下挖掘隧道移动。由于讨厌光线，所以会在太阳落山后来到地上。

description.en: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.
description.zh_cn: 三胞胎的感情一直很好，但在极少数情况下，也会为哪个脑袋先进食而激烈争吵。

description.en: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
description.zh_cn: 如果去垃圾场的话，就能看到它和黑暗鸦为争夺发光的东西而激烈打斗的景象。

description.en: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.
description.zh_cn: 虽然额头上的宝石颜色和阿罗拉猫老大的不一样，但成分却没什么两样。

description.en: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.
description.zh_cn: 使用念力会头痛，所以平时会尽量不做任何事，就在发呆中度过哦。

description.en: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.
description.zh_cn: 即便是游得很快的鱼宝可梦，它也能用定身法定住其行动，并轻易地进行捕捉。

description.en: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.
description.zh_cn: 该宝可梦会因一点小事而立刻动怒。由于不会积累压力，所以能活相当长的时间。

description.en: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.
description.zh_cn: 它不会原谅激怒它的人或宝可梦，会持续地追击对方。就算把对方揍得无法动弹也依然不会原谅对方。

description.en: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.
description.zh_cn: 熟悉后便会与人亲近，但野生的卡蒂狗会和岩狗狗就领地而展开激烈的争夺。

description.en: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.
description.zh_cn: 流传着这样一个传说。很久以前，它曾经和某位武将一起并肩战斗并治理国家。

description.en: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
description.zh_cn: 虽然危险，却向往登上陆地。因为它还只能晃晃悠悠地走路，所以被敌人发现后会慌忙逃入水中。

description.en: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.
description.zh_cn: 虽然已经能在陆地上生活，但还是栖息在有大量鱼宝可梦可捕食的水中。

description.en: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.
description.zh_cn: 虽然在水宝可梦中是属于游泳健将那一类的，但平时却生活在陆地上。

description.en: It uses various psychic powers even while it's sleeping, so you can't tell whether or not it's awake.
description.zh_cn: 即使是在睡梦中也会使用各种超能力，所以分辨不出它是不是醒着。

description.en: It stares at a silver spoon to amplify its psychic powers before it lets loose. Apparently, gold spoons are no good.
description.zh_cn: 会盯着银汤匙来增强并放出精神力量。用金汤匙好像就不行。

description.en: Alakazam uses its psychic powers to make the spoons it carries. Each spoon is an original that there's only one of in the whole world.
description.zh_cn: 手中的汤匙是胡地用超能力生成的。每把汤匙都是这世上独一无二的。

description.en: Once this Pokémon has gained enough confidence and muscle from training with its friends, it challenges Makuhita to a battle.
description.zh_cn: 在和伙伴们的锻炼中获得了自信和肌肉后，就会去向幕下力士挑战。

description.en: When it encounters an enemy that's truly mighty, this Pokémon removes the power-save belt from its waist and unleashes its full power.
description.zh_cn: 如果遇到了真正的强敌，就会解开腰上的力量限制腰带，并使出全力。

description.en: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."
description.zh_cn: 会用４只手臂捉住对手，并将其勒成一个复杂的形状。人称怪力式固定技。

description.en: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
description.zh_cn: 虽然体型瘦弱，但捕捉猎物时的动作却快到肉眼无法看清。

description.en: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
description.zh_cn: 叶子部分会变成刀刃切割对手。嘴里会吐出可溶化万物的液体。

description.en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description.zh_cn: 在丛林深处有一处遍地都是大食花的地带，进去后就再也出不来了。

description.en: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.
description.zh_cn: 会漂浮在海边寻找猎物。虽然有毒的触手也会断掉，但过一段时间就会重新长出来。

description.en: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.
description.zh_cn: 从红色珠子中发出超音波使猎物变得虚弱后，就会用８０根触手缠住对手。

description.en: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.
description.zh_cn: 活了很久的小拳石在身上的角被磨平后会变得圆滚滚的。性格也非常的冷静平稳。

description.en: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
description.zh_cn: 会爬上山崖前往山顶。到达山顶后，会立刻沿着来时的山路滚下去。

description.en: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
description.zh_cn: 年老后就不会蜕皮了。活过了漫长岁月的隆隆岩身上的外皮会长满苔藓变成绿色。

description.en: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
description.zh_cn: 刚出生时连站起来都十分不易。但跑得越多，腰腿就会被锻炼得越多，速度也会随之增加。

description.en: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description.zh_cn: 如果看到快速移动的物体，它就会想要前去较量一番，并用猛烈的速度开始追赶。

description.en: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.
description.zh_cn: 有传说讲呆呆兽打哈欠就会下雨，所以据说有些地方会供奉呆呆兽。

description.en: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.
description.zh_cn: 基本上一直在发呆。当尾巴被切断，大舌贝脱落后，它就会变回呆呆兽。

description.en: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.
description.zh_cn: 因为它时常会引发停电，所以有些发电厂会发出小磁怪讨厌的电波。

description.en: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.
description.zh_cn: 会发出神秘的电波，在三合一磁怪栖息的地方，精密机器会发生故障。

description.en: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
description.zh_cn: 手上拿着的茎也是重要的武器，能像刀一样挥舞并切断很多东西。

description.en: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
description.zh_cn: 因为突变而被发现的，有着２个脑袋的宝可梦。能以１００公里的时速奔跑。

description.en: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
description.zh_cn: 在３个脑袋的注视下，只要被发现一点空当，就会遭到鸟嘴的猛烈啄击。

description.en: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
description.zh_cn: 人们一直以为它只生活在寒冷的海域。它出现在阿罗拉的原因是个谜。

description.en: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.
description.zh_cn: 能以８节的速度在海里游动，并搜寻能当做猎物的宝可梦。特别喜欢吃弱丁鱼。

description.en: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.
description.zh_cn: 诞生于海底的污泥。在干净的地方，它就会因体内的细菌无法增长而死去。

description.en: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.
description.zh_cn: 食物变少数量也会急剧减少。为了防止它灭绝，人们开始了制造人工污泥池。

description.en: The sand that accumulates inside its shell eventually becomes a pearl. But the pearl gets in the way, so it spits it out and discards it.
description.zh_cn: 虽然留在壳里的沙子终会变成珍珠，但会因为碍事而被它吐掉。

description.en: If areas of Cloyster's very hard shell get damaged, those areas swell, gradually growing into large sharp spikes.
description.zh_cn: 拥有非常坚硬的外壳。外壳上的伤痕会逐渐隆起，长成大大的尖刺。

description.en: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 据说是怨念寄宿在了墓地散发出的气体中，并最终变成了宝可梦。

description.en: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.
description.zh_cn: 在没有月亮的晚上，鬼斯通会寻找可以诅咒的对象，所以不要外出走动比较好哦。

description.en: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.
description.zh_cn: 在世界各地都能听到耿鬼会去找坏孩子这样的传说。

description.en: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
description.zh_cn: 会在地下以惊人的势头挖洞前进寻找食物。通过后留下的洞穴会成为地鼠的巢穴。

description.en: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.
description.zh_cn: 能在娱乐设施的附近见到其身影。会偷吃那晚孩子们所做的美梦。

description.en: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.
description.zh_cn: 生活在阿罗拉的引梦貘人的目标主要是树枕尾熊。人倒不怎么会成为受害者。

description.en: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
description.zh_cn: 如果危险逼近，就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身，让身体看起来更大。

description.en: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
description.zh_cn: 虽然坚硬的钳子有着１万马力的力量，但因为太大而行动迟缓。

description.en: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
description.zh_cn: 在精灵球发售的同一时期被发现。据说两者之间有着某种联系。

description.en: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."
description.zh_cn: 稍微受点刺激就会爆炸。有着炸弹球的外号而令人恐惧。

description.en: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.
description.zh_cn: ６只加在一起算１只。即便出于某些原因少了１只，到了次日清晨也一定会变回６只。

description.en: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.
description.zh_cn: 会用精神力量来迎击敌人。３个脑袋会分别放出念力，所以威力也会变成３倍。

description.en: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.
description.zh_cn: 会思念已故的母亲而在夜里哭叫，因此会被其天敌秃鹰娜发现。

description.en: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
description.zh_cn: 会用力扔骨头击落秃鹰娜。人们认为它这是在给亲人报仇。

description.en: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
description.zh_cn: 腿能自由地伸缩，即使离得很远，也能把对手踢飞。

description.en: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
description.zh_cn: 会扭转着手臂出拳，就连混凝土也能打碎。每战斗３分钟就要休息一下。

description.en: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!
description.zh_cn: 不管是什么，都会用长舌头去舔舔看。被舔到的部位如果放着不管就会红肿发炎。

description.en: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
description.zh_cn: 薄薄的气球状身体里贮满了剧毒的瓦斯。它靠过来的话，会感觉很臭。

description.en: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
description.zh_cn: 这是一方膨胀另一方就会收缩的双胞胎瓦斯弹。它一直在体内混合着毒瓦斯。

description.en: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
description.zh_cn: 虽然头脑很差但力气很大，可以用撞击把高楼大厦撞得粉粹。

description.en: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.zh_cn: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。甚至能在２０００度的熔岩里生存。

description.en: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.
description.zh_cn: 其他宝可梦盯上了它那既美味又营养的蛋，在这追逐的过程中，它逃跑的速度好像变快了。

description.en: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
description.zh_cn: 覆盖有很多蠕动着的藤蔓，因此无法看清它的真面目。蓝色的藤蔓一生都会生长。

description.en: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.
description.zh_cn: 会把自己的孩子放入腹袋里保护起来。对于胆敢伤害自己孩子的家伙，会毫不留情地予以痛击。

description.en: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description.zh_cn: 据说有时会从水面上猛烈地喷射墨汁，击落飞行的虫子。

description.en: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
description.zh_cn: 如果糊里糊涂想去摸它的话，有时就会被它长在身体上的刺扎到而陷入昏厥。

description.en: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.
description.zh_cn: 虽然漂亮的尾鳍是其特征，但角金鱼之间好像会比谁的角更粗更尖锐。

description.en: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.
description.zh_cn: 头上的角会像钻头一样旋转，即便是坚硬的岩石也能一下子贯穿。雄性有着鲜艳的颜色。

description.en: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.
description.zh_cn: 在各地都流传着星屑掉到海里就会变成海星星这样的民间故事。

description.en: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.
description.zh_cn: 发光的核心被称为海之宝石。有人将它变成昂贵的饰品，在暗地里偷偷地买卖。

description.en: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
description.zh_cn: 有着非凡的默剧表演实力。在你看入迷的时候，不知不觉间就会出现一面真正的墙壁。

description.en: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.
description.zh_cn: ２把锋利的镰刀并不单单是武器。还能灵活地运用它们来切割猎物，然后食用。

description.en: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
description.zh_cn: 会按独特的节奏扭动腰部。栖息在阿罗拉的迷唇姐，那动作更是妙不可言。

description.en: Electricity permeates its body. It swings its arms round and round to charge up electricity before unleashing a punch.
description.zh_cn: 全身都带着电。会一圈圈抡动手臂进行充电后再出拳。

description.en: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!
description.zh_cn: 全身都在燃烧，光是呼出的气息就带着高温，打喷嚏时会同时喷出火焰。

description.en: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.
description.zh_cn: 会和锹农炮虫争夺领地。在阿罗拉，不知为何它和赫拉克罗斯的关系好像相当不错。

description.en: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.
description.zh_cn: 会组成一个群体生活。在群体中，谁的角最粗最长，并伤痕累累，谁就是老大。

description.en: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.
description.zh_cn: 在非常遥远的过去，它还是十分强大的，但随着时间的推移，它变得越来越弱，越来越弱了。

description.en: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."
description.zh_cn: 能不断地吐出破坏光线，将周围一带燃烧殆尽。也有一些地区称其为破坏神。

description.en: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢乘载着人游泳。在阿罗拉地区，这是重要的水上交通方式。

description.en: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.
description.zh_cn: 可以变身成任何东西，但好像每只百变怪都有着自己擅长和不擅长变形的东西。

description.en: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.
description.zh_cn: 至今未弄清为何只有伊布携带着非常不稳定的遗传基因。

description.en: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.
description.zh_cn: 美丽的水边是其主要的栖息地。如果感觉有外敌来袭，它就会跳入水中躲起来。

description.en: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.
description.zh_cn: 肺中有能产生电力的器官。从它的吐息中，能听到里面混杂着噼里啪啦的电流声。

description.en: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!
description.zh_cn: 大口吸入空气就是要攻击的前兆。这意味着１７００度的火焰即将来袭。

description.en: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.
description.zh_cn: 由大约２０年前的科学力量创造出来的宝可梦，所以现在很多部分已经过时了。

description.en: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.
description.zh_cn: 生活在古代海洋中的宝可梦。好像曾是始祖大鸟的食物，发现过带有齿痕的化石。

description.en: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.
description.zh_cn: 被认为是由于身上沉重的壳而灭绝的古代宝可梦。好像是章鱼桶的远祖。

description.en: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.
description.zh_cn: ３亿年前繁衍兴旺的宝可梦。据说在某些地区，至今仍能偶尔看见活着的化石盔。

description.en: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.
description.zh_cn: 为了在陆地上也能活动，身体开始了演化，但没等演化完，它就灭绝了。

description.en: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.
description.zh_cn: 由琥珀中残留的遗传基因复原而来。性情比想像的还要粗暴，甚至还出现了牺牲者。

description.en: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.
description.zh_cn: 平时不是吃就是睡，但如果因某些事而认真起来的话，好像就会发挥出惊人的力量。

description.en: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
description.zh_cn: 传说的鸟宝可梦。能冻结空气中的水分，制造出暴风雪。

description.en: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description.zh_cn: 会从云端落下巨大闪电，并随之现身的传说的鸟宝可梦。

description.en: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.
description.zh_cn: 从很久以前就因火鸟传说而闻名。每次拍动翅膀，羽毛都会明亮地燃烧起来，非常美丽。

description.en: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.
description.zh_cn: 由于还很弱小，所以会潜伏在水底悄悄地生活．靠着吃沉入水中的东西为生。

description.en: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.
description.zh_cn: 人们相信它能操纵天气，所以在哈克龙栖息的湖里，供品总是源源不断。

description.en: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."
description.zh_cn: 即便是狂风暴雨的海上，它也能波澜不惊地飞过。目睹过它那身姿的船长称其为大海的化身。

description.en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
description.zh_cn: 它是某位科学家长年累月持续进行可怕的遗传基因研究实验所诞生的成果。

description.en: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 因为能使用所有的招式，所以有很多学者认为它是宝可梦的祖先。

description.en: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.
description.zh_cn: 从头上的叶子那里会飘散出淡淡的甜香。性情温和，非常喜欢沐浴阳光。

description.en: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
description.zh_cn: 脖子周围散发出的好似香辛料般的香味有焕发活力的效果。

description.en: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description.zh_cn: 花瓣中散发出的气味里含有能够抚平好斗情绪的成分。

description.en: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description.zh_cn: 胆小怯懦，总是将身体缩成球形。受到袭击时会猛烈燃烧背上的火焰保护自己。

description.en: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
description.zh_cn: 战斗前会背过身去向对手展示自己的火焰有多么厉害。

description.en: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description.zh_cn: 愤怒到极点时，它热得能将碰到的所有东西瞬间点燃。

description.en: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
description.zh_cn: 个子虽小，却是个粗暴的家伙。只要眼前有东西在动，就会上去先咬一口再说。

description.en: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description.zh_cn: 即便牙齿掉了也会不断地重新长出来。嘴里总是长满着４８颗牙齿。

description.en: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
description.zh_cn: 虽然平时动作慢慢悠悠，但在扑咬猎物的时候，速度却快得无法看清。

description.en: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
description.zh_cn: 负责放哨的会通过尖叫或用尾巴拍打地面来通知伙伴注意危险。

description.en: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
description.zh_cn: 母亲会用细长的身体裹住孩子使其入睡。能用快速的动作追赶敌人。

description.en: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.
description.zh_cn: 每天必定会按固定的节奏倾斜脖子。过去人们会养它来代替时钟。

description.en: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."
description.zh_cn: 即便是在黑暗里，它的眼睛也能看得一清二楚，不会放过任何猎物。所以也被称为黑夜帝王。

description.en: This Pokémon is very sensitive to cold. In the warmth of Alola, it appears quite lively.
description.zh_cn: 非常怕冷的宝可梦。在温暖的阿罗拉，可以看到它生气勃勃的样子。

description.en: It's said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.
description.zh_cn: 据说它背上的花纹和夜空里的星星有关，但是具体情况至今未明。

description.en: With threads from its mouth, it fashions sturdy webs that won't break even if you set a rock on them.
description.zh_cn: 由它吐丝制成的巢穴非常坚固。即便放上１０公斤重的岩石也不会破掉。

description.en: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.
description.zh_cn: 每晚都会为了寻求猎物而四处游走。发现猎物时会吐丝封住对方的行动，然后用牙齿啃食。

description.en: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.
description.zh_cn: 牙齿锋利，就算在黑暗中被它咬住吸血也不会感到疼痛，所以无法立刻发觉。

description.en: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.
description.zh_cn: 会通过２根触手发出微光来吸引猎物。是一种在夜钓时很有用的宝可梦。

description.en: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在触手里的细菌在吸食电灯怪的体液时，会产生强烈的发光现象。

description.en: It still can't use electricity well. When it's surprised or excited, it discharges electricity unintentionally.
description.zh_cn: 仍旧很不擅长使用电力。一旦吃惊或是情绪高涨，就会立刻开始放电。

description.en: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!
description.zh_cn: 在流星众多的晚上，它们会聚集起来并围成一圈跳舞．如果能在那时看到它们，就会遇到一些好事情哦。

description.en: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!
description.zh_cn: 为了能动听地歌唱，它会一直练习唱歌。就算是睡着了，也会在梦中不停地歌唱哦。

description.en: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description.zh_cn: 壳内好像塞满了很多幸福，据说如果能温柔对待它，它就会把幸运分给对方。

description.en: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
description.zh_cn: 不待在温柔的人身边就会变得没有精神。不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。

description.en: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.
description.zh_cn: 虽然还无法飞行，但跳跃力超群。能跳上很高的树枝啄食树芽。

description.en: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
description.zh_cn: 据说该宝可梦虽然有着能预知未来的力量，但却没有能改变未来的力量。

description.en: Clothing made from Mareep's fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.
description.zh_cn: 用咩利羊的毛制成的衣服容易起静电，所以会做特殊加工。

description.en: In the places on its body where fleece doesn't grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn't conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.
description.zh_cn: 毛发不生有如橡胶一样的皮肤不会导电，即便触电了也很安全。

description.en: The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.
description.zh_cn: 尾巴上的光能传至宇宙，所以身在何处一目了然。因此它平时不会让尾巴发光。

description.en: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description.zh_cn: 有时能看到美丽花聚在一起做着像是跳舞一样的动作。据说这是呼唤太阳的仪式。

description.en: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
description.zh_cn: 全身的体毛有着能将水弹开的特性，所以就算碰到水也不会弄湿。

description.en: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
description.zh_cn: 长长的耳朵是灵敏的感应器。能够听出生物在河底移动的声音。

description.en: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.
description.zh_cn: 很受老年人喜爱，甚至还有关于它的专门杂志。它的爱好者很讲究它手臂的长度和角度。

description.en: Although its cries sound like screams, a composer created a beautiful ballad that was influenced by the sounds.
description.zh_cn: 明明叫声有如嚎叫一般，但某位作曲家却受其影响创作了优美的叙事曲。

description.en: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
description.zh_cn: 身体十分轻盈。为了不被吹走会牢牢地站稳在地面上。

description.en: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
description.zh_cn: 头顶上盛开着的花有着根据气温变化而开合的特性。

description.en: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
description.zh_cn: 会随季风环绕世界１周。途中会播撒棉孢子。

description.en: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.
description.zh_cn: 习惯用尾巴做各种事情后，手就变得不怎么灵活了。会在很高的树上筑巢。

description.en: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.
description.zh_cn: 会在某日清晨突然从天上掉下来。被烈雀袭击时，会猛烈地挥动叶子赶走对方。

description.en: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.
description.zh_cn: 随着炎热季节的临近，脸上的花瓣会变得更加鲜艳，同时它也会活动得更加频繁。

description.en: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey--even those behind it.
description.zh_cn: 有着头不动就可以３６０度全方位环视的眼睛，因此就算是正后方的猎物也不会看漏。

description.en: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description.zh_cn: 在冰冷的水中生活。附近天气变凉之后，也会来到地上觅食。

description.en: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
description.zh_cn: 性格悠闲自得。会在河底张开嘴巴静静地等着食物自己跳进来。

description.en: Although it originally had no powers at all, people say its precognitive faculties were awakened by its need to protect itself.
description.zh_cn: 本来没有任何能力，但据说为了保护自己从而觉醒了预知能力。

description.en: This Pokémon is nocturnal. Even in total darkness, its large eyes can spot its prey clearly!
description.zh_cn: 夜行性宝可梦。大大的瞳孔即便在一片漆黑中也能看清猎物的样子。

description.en: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
description.zh_cn: 对于发光的东西毫无抵抗力。为了追求宝物，有时候会潜入爱储存宝石的尖牙陆鲨的巢穴。

description.en: It's constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.
description.zh_cn: 脑海中经常会涌现出一些像是改变世界的想法，但不久后会依次忘记。

description.en: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.
description.zh_cn: 吓唬别人是其活着的意义。如果把耳朵贴近它脖子上的红珠子，就能从中听到悲鸣声。

description.en: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
description.zh_cn: 身体很薄，会一直贴在墙上。它的外形好像有着某种含义。

description.en: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
description.zh_cn: 讨厌光和冲击。受到攻击时，身体就会膨胀，反击也会因此变强。

description.en: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.
description.zh_cn: 睡觉时尾巴上的脑袋会监视周围的情况。尾巴不睡觉也没关系。

description.en: Motionless, it hangs from trees, waiting for its bug Pokémon prey to come to it. Its favorite in Alola is Cutiefly.
description.zh_cn: 会挂在树上静静等待作为它猎物的虫宝可梦送上门来。在阿罗拉，它喜欢吃的是萌虻。

description.en: When something approaches it, it fires off fragments of its steel shell in attack. This is not a conscious action but a conditioned reflex.
description.zh_cn: 只要一有东西靠近，它就会射出钢铁外壳的碎片进行攻击。这是一种无意识的条件反射。

description.en: It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another's tunnels happily.
description.zh_cn: 能挖掘地面移动。会友好地和地鼠共用各自的隧道。

description.en: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
description.zh_cn: 平时会贴在峭壁上。发现猎物后，就会张开翅膀乘风猛扑过去。

description.en: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
description.zh_cn: 由地下高压和高热锻炼出来的身体比任何金属都要坚硬。

description.en: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢亲近人，爱撒娇。它的动作与长相之间的反差好像会让年轻女性为之着迷。

description.en: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn't care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.
description.zh_cn: 颚的力量很强，但不喜欢争斗，所以很少有展露的机会。

description.en: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description.zh_cn: 为了发射全身的毒针，会一口气吞下１０升水来让身体膨胀起来。

description.en: Its body is like steel. Its tough, heavy pincers are more suited to smashing enemies than grabbing them.
description.zh_cn: 有着钢铁般的身体。比起夹住敌人，它粗重的钳子更适合用来把敌人砸扁。

description.en: The berries stored in its jar-like shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
description.zh_cn: 储存在壶形甲壳里的树果会在不知不觉间变成黏糊糊的果汁。

description.en: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.
description.zh_cn: 粗粗的角是其骄傲。在阿罗拉，锹农炮虫是它最大的竞争者，双方经常大打出手。

description.en: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.
description.zh_cn: 依靠团队合作从鸟宝可梦的巢穴里将蛋偷出来后，却会为了由谁来吃而争吵不休。

description.en: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they're soaked with honey.
description.zh_cn: 找到蜂蜜后，新月花纹就会闪闪发光。一直在舔渗有甜甜蜂蜜的手掌。

description.en: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
description.zh_cn: 能分辨出任何气味。即使是埋在地下深处的食物，它也能一个不剩地找出来。

description.en: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
description.zh_cn: 大量出现在火山地带。为了寻找温暖的地方，会慢吞吞地爬来爬去。

description.en: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
description.zh_cn: 背上的壳很容易崩裂，体内循环着的高热火焰会时不时地喷发出来。

description.en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description.zh_cn: 为了寻找食物，会用鼻子摩擦地面并进行挖掘。偶尔会挖到温泉。

description.en: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
description.zh_cn: 虽然４只脚很短，但因为蹄子很宽很粗糙，所以就算在雪地上行走也不会打滑。

description.en: The pink of Corsola that live in Alola is deep and vibrant, thanks to seas filled with nutrition.
description.zh_cn: 生活在阿罗拉的太阳珊瑚身上的粉红色非常鲜艳浓郁。这都是拜富含营养的大海所赐。

description.en: This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!
description.zh_cn: 会粘在巨翅飞鱼身上，吃一点残羹剩饭。如果巨翅飞鱼受到袭击，它就会与其一同战斗。

description.en: The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.
description.zh_cn: 逃跑时吐出来的墨汁很特别。里面有着能让嗅觉变迟钝的成分，连鼻子灵敏的宝可梦也能迷惑。

description.en: It shares its food with people who are stranded. Because Delibird is omnivorous, sometimes it gives those people bug Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 会把自己的食物分给遇难者。因为它是杂食性的宝可梦，所以有时会把虫宝可梦分给对方。

description.en: Postcards and posters featuring Mantine leaping elegantly above the waves are popular souvenirs of Alola.
description.zh_cn: 阿罗拉的人气特产是绘有巨翅飞鱼在海浪上优雅跳跃的明信片及海报。

description.en: The wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.
description.zh_cn: 用其脱落的翅膀加工制成的菜刀，锋利得足以让一流厨师都点头认可。

description.en: It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it's very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.
description.zh_cn: 擅长与伙伴的合作。如果成为同伴，就会非常听从训练家的命令。

description.en: They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.
description.zh_cn: 能喷出混有毒素的火焰结果对手。会和群体中的成员平分猎物。

description.en: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description.zh_cn: 平时好像会隐藏在海底洞穴中。打个哈欠就会引发潮旋。

description.en: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
description.zh_cn: 为了表达爱意会用鼻子撞过来，但因为力道太大，一不小心就会被它撞飞。

description.en: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its Tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
description.zh_cn: 牙齿又尖又硬，而且还有着结实的皮肤，所以它的撞击连房子都能撞毁。

description.en: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.
description.zh_cn: 搭载有ＡＩ。会自己学习各种各样的事情，但也会记住一些多余的东西。

description.en: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
description.zh_cn: 如果盯着它的角看，就会产生一种似乎要被吸入圆心的神奇感觉。

description.en: The fluid of Smeargle's tail secretions changes in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon's emotions change.
description.zh_cn: 从尾巴前端渗出的体液会随着图图犬情绪的变化而呈现不同的颜色。

description.en: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description.zh_cn: 永远都是精力充沛的样子。为了变强，就算输了一次又一次，也会不断地站起来迎战对手。

description.en: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.
description.zh_cn: 会像陀螺一样旋转着战斗。由于离心力的作用，破坏力可达到原来的１０倍。

description.en: When it examines things, before touching them with its hands, it makes lip contact and then diligently licks all the dirt off its lips.
description.zh_cn: 在确认某样东西时，会先用嘴唇而不是手去触碰试试。会经常用舌头舔去污渍。

description.en: When it hears the crash of thunder, Elekid's mood improves. It can be useful to record that sound and play it when Elekid's feeling down.
description.zh_cn: 听到打雷的声音会很高兴。如果事先将打雷的声音录下来，那么在它消沉的时候就能很方便地放给它听了哦。

description.en: When flames drip from its nose, that means it has a cold. Have it lie down for a nice rest in some magma.
description.zh_cn: 当火焰哧溜哧溜地从鼻子里漏出来时，就表示它感冒了。这时就让它去熔岩里休息会吧。

description.en: It produces over five gallons of milk a day. The higher the quality of the pastures it lives in, the richer and tastier its milk becomes.
description.zh_cn: 每天能产出２０升的牛奶。越是能长出优质牧草的土地，它所产出的牛奶也就越香浓可口。

description.en: Their eggs are such a delicacy that some say eating one will bring you happiness. These eggs fetch the highest prices on the market.
description.zh_cn: 这个蛋是天下一绝，甚至有吃下去就会获得幸福的说法。所以它在市场上的价格是最高的。

description.en: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description.zh_cn: 因为背着雨云，所以无论何时都能释放雷电。据说是和雷电一同降临的宝可梦。

description.en: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
description.zh_cn: 据传是每次新火山形成时都会出生的，会在大地上四处奔跑的宝可梦。

description.en: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
description.zh_cn: 在全世界四处奔跑，让污水重回清澈。会随北风奔跑着离去。

description.en: Born underground, it eats its way through dirt to the surface, where its parents are. It doesn't deal well with the bright light it finds there.
description.zh_cn: 诞生于地下，会一边吃着泥土，一边朝至亲所在的地面前进。因为光线刺眼，所以它不太能适应哦。

description.en: This troublesome Pokémon can't wait to evolve, so it relieves its stress by wildly propelling itself around using compressed gas.
description.zh_cn: 它是令人头痛的宝可梦。不等进化完成就会利用压缩气体四处乱飞大闹来纾解压力。

description.en: It wanders through the mountains seeking opponents to fight. If it finds an opponent that's not worthy, Tyranitar ignores it and wanders on.
description.zh_cn: 会在山中徘徊以寻求战斗对手。但如果遇到的是比自己弱小的对手，它就会视若无睹地离开。

description.en: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
description.zh_cn: 沉睡在很深的海沟底部。据说洛奇亚挥动翅膀的话，就会引起长达４０天的暴风雨。

description.en: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
description.zh_cn: 记载于神话中的宝可梦。说其身体闪耀着七彩光芒，飞过的地方会形成彩虹。

description.en: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description.zh_cn: 会穿越时光在各地游荡。据说在时拉比出现过的森林里，草木会生长得非常茂盛。

description.en: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.
description.zh_cn: 在垂直的墙壁上也能轻快地攀爬。会用尾巴感知空气的湿度，以此来判断明天的天气。

description.en: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
description.zh_cn: 发达的大腿肌肉会产生出惊人的爆发力和弹跳力。

description.en: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
description.zh_cn: 手臂上长出的叶子锋利得连大树都能“唰”地一刀砍倒。在密林中战斗无人能敌。

description.en: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
description.zh_cn: 肚子里有火袋。抱在怀里暖烘烘的很温暖。只要生命尚存火焰就会持续燃烧。

description.en: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
description.zh_cn: 有着１秒内连踢１０次的腿技。会用尖锐的叫声威吓对手。

description.en: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
description.zh_cn: 有着能跃过３０层大楼的弹跳力。火焰拳能将对手烧成灰烬。

description.en: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
description.zh_cn: 如果用大大的尾鳍划水的话，速度就会快速提升。身体虽小却充满了力量。

description.en: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
description.zh_cn: 腰腿十分结实，即使是在泥泞的地上也能稳步前进。会把身体埋进泥里睡觉。

description.en: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
description.zh_cn: 只要挥一挥如岩石般坚硬的手臂，就能将巨大的岩石打得粉碎。

description.en: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
description.zh_cn: 性格执着的宝可梦。一旦盯上某个猎物，就会追到对方精疲力尽。

description.en: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
description.zh_cn: 绝对服从优秀训练家的命令。这是因为它还残留有很久以前群体行动的习性。

description.en: It walks in zigzag fashion. It's good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
description.zh_cn: 此宝可梦很擅长通过之字形走路来发现埋藏在草丛或地里的宝物。

description.en: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
description.zh_cn: 笔直奔跑的速度可以轻松超越１００公里的时速，但非常不擅长弯道。

description.en: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
description.zh_cn: 非常喜欢吃叶子。受到姆克儿的袭击时，会用尾部的刺击退对方。

description.en: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
description.zh_cn: 会将丝线缠在树枝上。一边喝着丝线上挂着的雨水，一边等待着进化的那一刻。

description.en: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
description.zh_cn: 色彩鲜艳的翅膀花纹是其特征。会伸出细细的嘴巴吸取甜甜的花蜜。

description.en: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
description.zh_cn: 由柔软的丝线形成的身体会随着时间逐渐变硬。如果出现裂纹就表示快要进化了。

description.en: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
description.zh_cn: 夜行性宝可梦。被灯光引诱的毒粉蛾会把行道树上的叶子吃得一塌糊涂。

description.en: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.
description.zh_cn: 酷似水草的宝可梦。会把不会游泳的宝可梦放在叶子上送至对岸。

description.en: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water-grass by day and becomes active at night.
description.zh_cn: 住在日照良好的水边。白天在水草做的床上睡觉，太阳下山后就会出来活动。

description.en: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.
description.zh_cn: 如果听到欢快的音乐，体内就会充满力量，会情不自禁地跳起舞来。

description.en: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
description.zh_cn: 会将头顶粘在树枝上悬挂着。也有被大风吹落的时候。

description.en: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
description.zh_cn: 长鼻叶吹奏出的草笛声会让人感到不安。它居住在森林的深处。

description.en: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.
description.zh_cn: 过去被敬畏为森林之神的宝可梦。有着读取对手想法并抢先一步行动的能力。

description.en: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
description.zh_cn: 有着不管是怎样强大的对手都敢于前去迎战的毅力。会向着温暖的土地飞行。

description.en: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
description.zh_cn: ２根尾羽笔直地竖起就是健康的证明。会在空中优雅地飞来飞去。

description.en: With its long, thin wings, it catches updrafts and flies like a glider high up into the sky.
description.zh_cn: 翅膀又细又长。能乘着上升气流，像滑翔机一样在空中翱翔。

description.en: It places small Pokémon into its spacious beak and carries them around. No one knows where it's taking them.
description.zh_cn: 会将小型宝可梦放入它那鼓得大大的鸟嘴中运送。但是要把它带到哪儿去就不得而知了。

description.en: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
description.zh_cn: 用红色的角捕捉到人和宝可梦的温情后，全身也会稍稍变暖起来。

description.en: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
description.zh_cn: 训练家开朗的情绪是精神力量的源泉。开心时会旋转着跳舞。

description.en: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
description.zh_cn: 如果是为了保护训练家，它就会用尽自己的精神力量制造出小型黑洞。

description.en: If it's in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.
description.zh_cn: 如果遇到危险，就会从突起的地方分泌出甜汁。收集它制成糖浆，然后涂抹在面包上就会非常可口。

description.en: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns of its eyespots. If that doesn't work, it deftly makes its escape on its set of four wings.
description.zh_cn: 会用眼珠花纹威吓敌人。如果这样不起作用，就会挥动４根翅膀，灵活地四处逃窜。

description.en: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢潮湿的地方，白天会呆在森林的树荫里一动不动。会从头上放出毒粉。

description.en: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
description.zh_cn: 短短的手臂在出拳时会猛地一下伸长。有着能令职业拳击手汗颜的技术。

description.en: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
description.zh_cn: 懒人獭慵懒的样子会深深地刺激看着它的人的懒惰之心。

description.en: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.
description.zh_cn: 由于心跳很快，浑身的血液都在沸腾，所以１秒都停不下来。

description.en: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.
description.zh_cn: 世界上最吊儿郎当的宝可梦。如果吃光了触手能及范围内的食物，就会换个地方居住。

description.en: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
description.zh_cn: 因为长时间生活在地下，所以眼睛几乎什么都看不到。会靠触角来探察周围的情况。

description.en: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
description.zh_cn: 如果一直听它的叫声，就会让人头痛不止。会以眼睛无法看清的速度移动。

description.en: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.
description.zh_cn: 蜕下的壳有了灵魂。从它背上的缝隙向里面窥视的话，灵魂好像就会被吸走。

description.en: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
description.zh_cn: 平时细声细气。如果察觉到危险就会大叫。把耳朵的盖子合上会停止大叫。

description.en: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
description.zh_cn: 深深吸入空气后，会靠发达的腹肌将其吐出，并以此来发出大叫声。

description.en: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
description.zh_cn: 爆音怪的长嚎能传至１０公里之外。会从身上的多个洞里发出各种声音。

description.en: It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.
description.zh_cn: 会朝着树干反复练习巴掌招数。有时会因为朝着椰蛋树练习巴掌招数而被扔飞。

description.en: Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they're also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.
description.zh_cn: 虽然喜欢比试力气，但心地和善且注重礼仪，会慰劳自己的对战对手。

description.en: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
description.zh_cn: 坐在大尾巴上跳动的话，就可以在地上快速移动。是生活在水边的宝可梦。

description.en: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.
description.zh_cn: １年只会移动１厘米。但在陷入危机时会旋转身体，瞬间潜入地下。

description.en: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
description.zh_cn: 不由自主地就会去追动的东西。会追着自己的尾巴，一圈圈地原地打转。

description.en: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
description.zh_cn: 非常讨厌肮脏的地方。会在舒适的地方一直打理自己的毛发。

description.en: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.
description.zh_cn: 用坚硬的爪子掘土，用粗粗的牙齿嘎嘣嘎嘣地嚼宝石。非常喜欢吃小碎钻。

description.en: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
description.zh_cn: 狡黠而又恐怖的宝可梦。用可爱的举止让人麻痹大意，然后出其不意地用大颚一口吞下。

description.en: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
description.zh_cn: 虽然平时住在深山里，但肚子饿了就会出现在山脚下，吃铁轨或者车辆。

description.en: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
description.zh_cn: 非常喜欢吃铁矿石。会用钢铁之躯互相撞击来争夺领地。

description.en: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.
description.zh_cn: 会把一整座山都当做自己领地。伤痕越多的波士可多拉经历的战斗就越多，所以不能轻视。

description.en: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
description.zh_cn: 总是在深山里修行。通过冥想提高精神力后，身体就会飘浮起来。

description.en: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
description.zh_cn: 会用跳舞一般的优雅动作一边躲避攻击，一边向对手施展强烈的一击。

description.en: Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
description.zh_cn: 通过空气与体毛的摩擦产生静电。落雷兽如果奔跑，会发出噼里啪啦的声音。

description.en: Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
description.zh_cn: 在不自然的雷云之下有着雷电兽。听说会用和雷同等的速度奔驰。

description.en: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
description.zh_cn: 会制造火花拉拉球来给伙伴加油。能从电线杆上吸取电力。

description.en: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
description.zh_cn: 负电拍拍和正电拍拍放出的电流有促进血液流动，缓解酸痛的功效。

description.en: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise's sweet aroma.
description.zh_cn: 到了晚上会亮起臀部与伙伴交流。非常喜欢甜甜萤放出的甜甜香气。

description.en: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
description.zh_cn: 会利用甜甜的香气诱导电萤虫在夜空中描绘２００种以上的图形。

description.en: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
description.zh_cn: 会用右手和左手分别放出２种不同的毒来进行攻击。香气越浓越有精神。

description.en: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
description.zh_cn: 心脏和大脑都很小，身体的大部分是胃。会分泌出什么都能溶解的胃液。

description.en: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
description.zh_cn: 不管是什么都会整个吞掉。会将毛孔中分泌出的剧毒体液撒向敌人。

description.en: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!
description.zh_cn: 非常胆小，１只的话不会去狩猎。如果聚集了５只左右的话，就会一下子变得很粗暴。

description.en: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.
description.zh_cn: 人们相信，如果带着它脱落的牙齿就不会在海上遭遇事故，因此会将牙齿加工为饰品等。

description.en: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.
description.zh_cn: 会张着嘴游泳，将食物连同海水一起吃下去。不要的水会从鼻子里喷出来舍弃。

description.en: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.
description.zh_cn: 因为会吃太多的鱼宝可梦，所以数量增加过多的话，会被渔夫们驱赶。

description.en: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
description.zh_cn: 会把灼热的熔岩储存在背上的驼峰里。一旦淋了雨，熔岩就会冷却，动作也会变得迟缓。

description.en: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
description.zh_cn: 背上的驼峰火山每１０年就会进行一次大喷发，但暴怒时也会喷发。

description.en: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.
description.zh_cn: 通过甲壳里喷出的烟就能了解它的身体状况。势头很旺时，说明很有精神。

description.en: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
description.zh_cn: 会用尾巴代替弹簧，一直在跳来跳去。靠跳跃时的震动来使心脏跳动。

description.en: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.
description.zh_cn: 会用黑珍珠增强自己的精神力量，并用奇妙的舞步操纵对手的心。

description.en: Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.
description.zh_cn: 晃晃悠悠，步伐不稳健。如果长时间连续行走，就会变得状态很差。

description.en: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.
description.zh_cn: 颚部连岩石也能弄碎，但很重，如果翻身了，就会爬不起来。黑眼鳄会趁这个空当袭击它。

description.en: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.
description.zh_cn: 振动翅膀，发出超音波。会把晕厥的猎物活埋在沙子里保存。

description.en: By flapping their wings, Flygon cause sandstorms that conceal Krookodile. The team then splits the prey they catch.
description.zh_cn: 挥动翅膀卷起沙暴，让流氓鳄潜伏在那里。捉到的猎物会一起分享。

description.en: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在少雨的干燥地方。黄色的花朵１年绽放１次。

description.en: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.
description.zh_cn: 到了夜间会开始活动。会找出并捉住那些因受不了沙漠炎热而精疲力竭的猎物。

description.en: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.
description.zh_cn: 不知道为什么，它非常喜欢轻轻地站在人头上并伪装成帽子的模样。

description.en: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.
description.zh_cn: 会悠然地飞翔在天空之中。听见七夕青鸟优美的哼唱，就会让人心醉神迷，仿佛置身梦境。

description.en: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
description.zh_cn: 好几个世代以来一直在与饭匙蛇战斗。锋利的爪子是它最强的武器。

description.en: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
description.zh_cn: 会用渗出剧毒的锋利尾巴来对抗敏捷的猫鼬斩。

description.en: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
description.zh_cn: 满月之夜会变得特别活跃，因此它的这一习性据说和月亮的圆缺有关。

description.en: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
description.zh_cn: 太阳能量是其力量之源，所以白天会很强。旋转时身体会发光。

description.en: Its entire body is gooey. When pecked at by bird Pokémon, it slips and slides its way to freedom.
description.zh_cn: 全身滑腻腻的。即使被鸟宝可梦啄到，也能哧溜一下滑着逃走。

description.en: Whiscash shakes the ground at high intensities to intimidate its opponents. It swallows its prey whole—along with mud from the swamp floor.
description.zh_cn: 猛烈地摇晃地面，威吓对手。会将沼泽底部的猎物连同泥巴一起整个吞下。

description.en: Individuals that have been set free by Trainers who could no longer raise them have become common, and they can now be found in Alola.
description.zh_cn: 被没有坚持培育的训练家放生了的个体在增加，即使在阿罗拉也变得时常能见到了。

description.en: Its temperament is rough and it loves to fight, but as soon as its pincers break off, it turns cowardly. It stays timid until they grow back.
description.zh_cn: 性格暴躁，喜欢打架，但如果钳子掉落，就会一下子弱下来。在再生之前，都会提心吊胆的。

description.en: Depictions of Pokémon similar to Baltoy have been found on the walls of caves where primitive humans lived.
description.zh_cn: 在原始人所居住的洞穴墙壁上，描绘着像是天秤偶的宝可梦的样子。

description.en: If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.
description.zh_cn: 如果淋湿，身体就会溶解掉。所以下雨时会用精神力量包住全身，保护自己。

description.en: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.
description.zh_cn: 曾生活在古代温暖的海里。伪装成海草，埋伏着等待猎物，等对方靠近的时候一口吞下。

description.en: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.
description.zh_cn: 平常栖息在海的浅滩底部，退潮的时候就爬到陆地上，四处寻找猎物。

description.en: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.
description.zh_cn: 从化石复原而来的太古羽虫即使放到海里，也不会有精神。因为现在的水质已和当时不同了。

description.en: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.
description.zh_cn: 生活在陆地上，曾为了寻找猎物而出发去海里狩猎。锐利的爪子是它最大的武器。

description.en: They look ragged, so no one catches them. They look like they'd taste bad, so predators won't eat them. And their numbers continue to grow.
description.zh_cn: 因为破破烂烂的，谁也不要捉。因为看起来不好吃，也不会被当做猎物。结果就是，数量嗖嗖地增加起来。

description.en: While Milotic is said to be the most beautiful Pokémon, Trainers who like Feebas and have raised it are seemingly disappointed by Milotic.
description.zh_cn: 被称为最美的宝可梦，对于因喜爱丑丑鱼而培育它的训练家，好像很微妙。

description.en: Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.
description.zh_cn: 样子会根据天气发生变化。但这是根据化学反应的结果，似乎并不是出于它的本意。

description.en: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.
description.zh_cn: 能改变身体的颜色，融入周围景色中。如果长时间不管它，就会闹别扭不现身。

description.en: It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.
description.zh_cn: 因为会吞食类似于怨恨、嫉妒之类的感情，所以对于有的人来说是可贵的存在。

description.en: It's a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.
description.zh_cn: 怨念附在被丢弃的玩偶身上，打算寻找丢弃自己的人来报仇。

description.en: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
description.zh_cn: 会无止境地追逐猎物。性格十分执着，但是太阳升起后就会放弃。

description.en: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
description.zh_cn: 一旦窥视到其体内燃烧着的灵火，自己的灵魂就会被其吸走。

description.en: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在阿罗拉的热带龙脖子里结的那串水果比其他地区的甜得多，是最最棒的。

description.en: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
description.zh_cn: 用头部的吸盘悬挂在树枝或是房子的屋檐下。会灵活运用７种音色。

description.en: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.
description.zh_cn: 不祥的只是它的外表。实际上它是会帮忙守护田地，或是告知人们异变的难能可贵的存在。

description.en: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
description.zh_cn: 具有集体行动的习性。睡觉的时候会聚集在洞窟中，和伙伴们把身体挨在一起。

description.en: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.
description.zh_cn: 雪和冰是它的主要食物。在温暖的阿罗拉只能在限定的地方生存。

description.en: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.
description.zh_cn: 将猎物冻住，整个咬住。但喜欢吃的是迷你冰等原本就冻着的宝可梦。

description.en: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.
description.zh_cn: 游泳还不是很熟练，用翻滚会移动得更快。高兴时大家会一起拍手。

description.en: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
description.zh_cn: 鼻子的神经很敏感。对于第一次看到的物体，会用鼻子碰触来记住。

description.en: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
description.zh_cn: 能用獠牙咬碎巨大的冰块。厚厚的脂肪不仅能抵御严寒，还能反弹敌人的攻击。

description.en: Despite its appearance, it's carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn't let go until they stop moving.
description.zh_cn: 别看它长这样，它可是食肉的。用２片外壳牢牢夹住猎物，直到完全不动了才会放开。

description.en: It's not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.
description.zh_cn: 游泳能力不太强。会挥动尾巴来吸引猎物，在很接近的时候一口咬住。

description.en: The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.
description.zh_cn: 身体的颜色根据水温而变化。阿罗拉的樱花鱼呈现出令人炫目的鲜艳色彩。

description.en: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.
description.zh_cn: 曾被认为已经灭绝。古空棘鱼的名字是模仿发现者的名字而起的。

description.en: There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.
description.zh_cn: 如果拥有它的心形鳞片，就能交往到恋人。也曾有个时期因为这个谣传而遭到滥捕。

description.en: Whenever it sees bird Pokémon flying through the sky, it becomes envious and smashes its surroundings to bits with headbutts.
description.zh_cn: 每次见到在空中飞行的鸟宝可梦，就会变得非常羡慕，而用头锤把周围的东西砸得粉碎。

description.en: The cells within its body are changing at a bewildering pace. Its hard shell is made from the same substance as bone.
description.zh_cn: 体内的细胞正处于千变万化的时期。坚硬的壳与骨头的成分相同。

description.en: Overjoyed at finally being able to fly, it flies all over the place and usually doesn't land until it's completely exhausted and needs to sleep.
description.zh_cn: 因为终于能飞的喜悦，而在天空四处疾飞。不到精疲力竭要睡觉就几乎不落地。

description.en: Instead of blood, magnetism flows through its body. When it's feeling bad, try giving it a magnet.
description.zh_cn: 体内循环着的不是血液而是磁力。身体状况不好时，就给它磁铁吧。

description.en: With its two brains, it fires powerful psychic energy to stop its prey in their tracks.
description.zh_cn: 会从２个大脑里放射出强力的精神能量，封住猎物的行动。

description.en: It boasts not only psychic powers but also fantastic strength. It grabs its prey with its four legs and holds them in place with its claws.
description.zh_cn: 不只是精神力量，还以怪力而自豪。能用４只脚抓住猎物，用爪子封住对方的行动。

description.en: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
description.zh_cn: 全身由岩石构成。即使在战斗中身体受损也能通过贴上岩石来治愈。

description.en: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.
description.zh_cn: 据说曾在冰河中沉睡了数千年。即使在熔岩中也无法融化其身体。

description.en: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
description.zh_cn: 经过长达几万年地下压力的锤炼，金属的身躯变得刀枪不入。

description.en: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
description.zh_cn: 通过心灵感应交流情感。用能令光发生折射的羽毛包裹身体来让自己隐形。

description.en: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
description.zh_cn: 拥有很高智商的宝可梦。收起前肢飞行的话，速度能超越喷气式飞机。

description.en: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
description.zh_cn: 神话中的宝可梦，它用大雨和大海啸扩张海洋。曾与固拉多激烈交战。

description.en: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
description.zh_cn: 据说能用高温蒸发水分扩张大地。曾与盖欧卡激烈交战。

description.en: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
description.zh_cn: 因为栖息在高高的云层之上的臭氧层，所以从地面无法看见它的样子。

description.en: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
description.zh_cn: 从遥远的过去就一直流传着这样的传说，它会在醒来时实现写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。

description.en: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 附着在陨石上的宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ变异后生成的宝可梦。

description.en: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
description.zh_cn: 沐浴着阳光，用全身进行光合作用。甲壳是泥土变硬后形成的。

description.en: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.zh_cn: 生活在森林中的水边。白天会去森林的外面，让甲壳上的树木晒晒阳光。

description.en: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
description.zh_cn: 在遥远的过去，人们曾假想过，在大地的下面存在着巨大土台龟。

description.en: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.
description.zh_cn: 屁屁的火焰以腹部产生的瓦斯为燃料。即使被雨淋到也不会熄灭。

description.en: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
description.zh_cn: 能熟练控制尾部火焰的大小，以自己擅长的距离进行战斗。

description.en: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
description.zh_cn: 性格像头上燃烧的火焰一样激烈。在速度方面无可匹敌。

description.en: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.
description.zh_cn: 非常讨厌被别人照顾。因为不听训练家的指示，所以要和它关系变好是很困难的。

description.en: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.zh_cn: 不集结成群，独来独往。似乎所有波皇子都认为自己是最了不起的。

description.en: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
description.zh_cn: 能以不输摩托艇的速度游泳。翅膀的边缘很锐利，能将浮冰切断。

description.en: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.zh_cn: 会很多只一起群体行动。虽然身体很小，但拍打翅膀的力量非常强。

description.en: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
description.zh_cn: 有组成庞大的团队来行动的习性。各个团队之间的争斗很激烈。

description.en: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 翅膀和脚的肌肉很发达，能抓着小的宝可梦轻轻松松地飞行。

description.en: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.zh_cn: 遇到任何事都不慌不忙，神经很大条的家伙。能做出与外表不符的灵敏动作。

description.en: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
description.zh_cn: 勤劳地用锐利的门牙啃断树枝和树根，堆积起来在水边筑巢。

description.en: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
description.zh_cn: 用互相撞击触角发出的声音和伙伴对话。那音色是秋夜的风景诗。

description.en: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.zh_cn: 鸣叫的时候会将刀子般的前臂交叉在胸前。即兴创作出旋律。

description.en: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
description.zh_cn: 每当活动身体时，肌肉就会伸缩产生电。危机时刻，身体会发光。

description.en: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.zh_cn: 从爪子释放出一击就能令人晕厥的电流。由数只组成团队生活。

description.en: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
description.zh_cn: 瞳孔闪着金色时，能发现躲藏在墙壁另一侧的猎物。

description.en: When it feels the sun's warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
description.zh_cn: 如果沐浴到温暖的阳光，花苞就会打开，飞散出花粉。住在清澈的水边。

description.en: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
description.zh_cn: 用甜甜的香气引诱猎物，并用双臂的毒刺鞭刺入或勒紧，以了结对方。

description.en: A primeval Pokémon, it possesses a hard and sturdy skull, lacking any intelligence within.
description.zh_cn: 太古时代的宝可梦。拥有坚硬而结实的头盖骨，但是脑子相当不好使。

description.en: In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.
description.zh_cn: 过去的人们曾在挖出化石后，用比钢铁还硬的头盖骨做成头盔。

description.en: A mild-mannered, herbivorous Pokémon, it used its face to dig up tree roots to eat. The skin on its face was plenty tough.
description.zh_cn: 食草的温顺宝可梦。用结实的脸部皮肤挖掘地面，连树根之类的也会吃。

description.en: The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.
description.zh_cn: 脸部的骨头又大又硬，所以在复原成功前，一直被错误地认作了脊椎。

description.en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.zh_cn: 为了抵御寒冷的秋风，会用小树枝和落叶当材料，做成蓑衣裹在身上。

description.en: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
description.zh_cn: 根据进化地点的不同，样子会发生变化。身边的材料会成为身体的一部分。

description.en: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
description.zh_cn: 非常喜欢吃花蜜。会抢夺三蜜蜂采集到的蜜，然后自己吃掉。

description.en: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
description.zh_cn: 从出生时起就是３只一起。为了取悦蜂女王，一直都在采集着花蜜。

description.en: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
description.zh_cn: 躯体是孩子们的巢穴。释放出各种各样的费洛蒙，自由地控制孩子们。

description.en: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.zh_cn: 把储存了静电帕奇作响的毛球和最喜欢吃的树果一起藏在树干的洞穴里。

description.en: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
description.zh_cn: 会像螺旋桨一样旋转２条尾巴来游泳。潜水的时候浮囊会瘪掉。

description.en: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.zh_cn: 用发达的浮囊浮在水面。是会帮忙拯救溺水者的宝可梦。

description.en: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
description.zh_cn: 在阳光下会渐渐变红。吸收养分，小球瘪掉的话，就是说快要进化了。

description.en: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
description.zh_cn: 花苞沐浴阳光后，会绽开花瓣并活泼地动起来。

description.en: While they normally live in the sea, they can function on land, too, until their skin dries out.
description.zh_cn: 平常在海里生活，但只要皮肤没有干燥，也可以在陆地活动。

description.en: Long ago, it had a shell on its back. There's now a vestigial plate on its back that's hard but thin.
description.zh_cn: 曾经一直背着壳。在背的里面有着又硬又薄的壳的痕迹。

description.en: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.
description.zh_cn: 围绕着舒适的树木的问题，一直在和投掷猴群体争夺领地。但结果是五五分。

description.en: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.
description.zh_cn: 圆圆的身体里塞满了许多魂魄。每次带着谁一起走的时候，身体就会鼓起来。

description.en: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.
description.zh_cn: 谣传说，如果被乘着风在暮色里飞行的随风球捉住，就会被运送往那个世界。

description.en: Its arms and legs are weak, but when it rolls its ears up tight and then unleashes them with its full force, it can smash boulders to dust.
description.zh_cn: 手脚的力量很弱，但如果死命伸长紧紧卷起的耳朵，连大岩石也能粉碎。

description.en: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
description.zh_cn: 一年会换２次毛。用这个毛制作的围巾和帽子非常温暖。

description.en: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.
description.zh_cn: 因为四处作祟，播撒诅咒而被人们所恐惧。也会随性地使用帮助人类的咒文。

description.en: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
description.zh_cn: 绝对不能容忍失败或是背叛的跟班。是为了维持群体的秩序，不得已而为之的。

description.en: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.zh_cn: 一不称心，就会竖起爪子。但偶尔会从喉咙里发出声响来撒娇，这样的性格很受部分人喜爱。

description.en: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
description.zh_cn: 即使是其他宝可梦的住所，如果感觉很舒服的话，就会赖着当做自己的住所。

description.en: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
description.zh_cn: 每次跳跃都会发出铃铃声。用高频率的叫声让对手失聪。

description.en: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
description.zh_cn: 从屁屁喷出的臭液的气味会扩散到半径２公里的范围，周围的宝可梦都会逃得无影无踪。

description.en: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.zh_cn: 从尾巴尖端喷出带有恶臭的液体进行攻击。喷射距离能达到５０米以上。

description.en: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.
description.zh_cn: 过去的人们相信，铜镜怪背上的花纹里蕴藏着神秘的力量。

description.en: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
description.zh_cn: 从遥远的过去开始就作为能召唤雨云的宝可梦被供奉着。时不时会被埋入地下。

description.en: It discharges moisture from its eyes, making it look like it's crying—apparently an effective way of getting enemies to let down their guard.
description.zh_cn: 会从眼睛里排出水分。看起来就像是正在哭泣，所以似乎也有让敌人麻痹大意的效果。

description.en: It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it's still not very good at it.
description.zh_cn: 会拼命地模仿对方的动作和表情。但还说不上模仿得很好。

description.en: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.
description.zh_cn: 是非常温顺的宝可梦，但如果被夺走了腹部的圆石头，就会哭着大吵大闹。

description.en: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.
description.zh_cn: 通过发出与对手相同的叫声，让对方深信自己是同伴，从而免受袭击。

description.en: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.zh_cn: １０８个魂魄聚集在一起生成的宝可梦。被绑缚在楔石的裂缝里。

description.en: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.
description.zh_cn: 会对动的东西发生反应，飞扑过去咬住。有时候会伤到自己，但也不太在意。

description.en: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.
description.zh_cn: 非常喜欢发光的东西。如果发现正在攻击小碎钻的勾魂眼，就会非常生气地发动袭击。

description.en: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
description.zh_cn: 以音速飞行，寻找猎物。围绕着食物的问题，和暴飞龙展开空中战。

description.en: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.
description.zh_cn: 长长的毛发下面藏着食物，但有时也会忘记藏了东西而发生异臭的问题。

description.en: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.
description.zh_cn: 能看见被称为波导的一种波，感知人和宝可梦的心情。不会靠近危险的对手。

description.en: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.
