description.zh_cn: 它集中精神所放出的一种神奇的波，被称为波导，连巨大的岩石都能击得粉碎。

description.en: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.zh_cn: 在干燥的土地生活。是身体会分泌出沙粒而不是汗水的宝可梦。

description.en: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
description.zh_cn: 嘴巴张得大大的，炫耀自己的强大。向上卷起大量的沙子进行攻击。

description.en: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.zh_cn: 用尾巴上的钩爪夹住猎物并注入毒素。很执着，毒不发作就绝不松开。

description.en: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
description.zh_cn: 用引以为傲的力量把对手打得七零八落，而且还要用剧毒给对手致命一击。

description.en: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.zh_cn: 脸颊上带有毒囊。会抓住对手的空当，用渗透了剧毒的手指猛戳。

description.en: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
description.zh_cn: 喉咙里带有毒囊。如果从喉咙发出声响，储存的毒素会被炼制得更强劲。

description.en: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.zh_cn: 先用甜香的唾液引诱猎物，然后用大颚大口地嚼。要花１整天吃掉猎物。

description.en: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.
description.zh_cn: 粉红色的花纹到了夜里就会发光。很受潜水者欢迎，所以有时会被驯养在度假地。

description.en: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.
description.zh_cn: 深海的海底猎物很少。四处寻找宝贵的食物，和电灯怪展开激烈争夺。

description.en: It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.
description.zh_cn: 非常不认生，很容易亲近。与小球飞鱼的互动巡游是非常受欢迎的海滩活动。

description.en: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
description.zh_cn: 在寒冷的季节里，会迁移到山脚下，一到春天就会返回积雪残留的山顶。

description.en: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."
description.zh_cn: 会引发暴风雪，让周围变得一片雪白。别名叫冰雪怪物。

description.en: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.
description.zh_cn: １只负责绊住穿山鼠的脚，将其翻过来后，另１只用锐利的爪子给予致命一击。

description.en: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.
description.zh_cn: 用雷达监视着自己的领地。一旦发现入侵者，就会立即用破坏光线惩治。

description.en: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.
description.zh_cn: 会举行看谁舌头伸得远的大赛。目前的最高纪录是２５米。

description.en: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
description.zh_cn: 从手掌的洞里发射出小拳石。全身的护具连火山喷发都能经受住。

description.en: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.zh_cn: 伸出由植物的藤蔓长成的手臂缠住猎物。即便手臂被吃掉也毫不在意。

description.en: It grips its tail, which spews electricity, and then beats down opponents with the power of its electrified fist.
description.zh_cn: 握住冒着电火花的尾巴做成带电的拳头后，就会用尽全力猛殴。

description.en: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.
description.zh_cn: 至今仍依靠鸭嘴炎兽的火焰来加工金属的工厂也不少。

description.en: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
description.zh_cn: 据说，波克基斯会访问没有争端的和平之地，给那里带去各种恩惠。

description.en: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
description.zh_cn: 高速飞行着，在擦肩而过的瞬间咬断对手的脖子。它热衷这样的战斗方式。

description.en: Although it doesn't like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.
description.zh_cn: 本身并不好斗，但如果是为了保护伙伴，就会削尖尾巴上的叶片，变成刀刃来作战。

description.en: It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.zh_cn: 把体毛冻住，变成锐利的针来保护身体。体温最低可下降到零下６０度。

description.en: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.zh_cn: 用尾巴倒挂在树枝上观察猎物。瞅准空当就从上空发动袭击。

description.en: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
description.zh_cn: 从遥远的过去就存在的宝可梦，甚至在１万年前的冰层中也发现过它。

description.en: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.
description.zh_cn: 不稳定的举动很惹人注目。这问题好像要归咎于负责升级程序的技术人员的水平。

description.en: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
description.zh_cn: 因为有着能敏锐感知对手想法的能力，所以可以率先攻击。

description.en: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.
description.zh_cn: 操纵着被称为小朝北鼻的部件，但这些部件好像偶尔也会迷路，没法回来。

description.en: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
description.zh_cn: 据说，会把无处可去的魂魄吸入它那具有弹力的身体中，并带往另一个世界。

description.en: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.
description.zh_cn: 把前来爬雪山的登山男冻成冰块，带回自己的巢穴。而且只会盯上美男子。

description.en: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
description.zh_cn: 作为驱动特殊马达的动力能源而被长期研究的宝可梦。

description.en: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.zh_cn: 被称为知识之神。据说拥有消除与之目光交会者的记忆的力量。

description.en: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.zh_cn: 教会了人们悲伤的痛苦和快乐的宝贵。被称为感情之神。

description.en: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.zh_cn: 被称为意志之神。一直沉睡在湖底，维持着世界的平衡。

description.en: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
description.zh_cn: 由于帝牙卢卡的诞生，时间才开始流动。是有着这样传说的宝可梦。

description.en: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
description.zh_cn: 据说居住在平行排列的空间狭缝中，是出现在神话中的宝可梦。

description.en: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在火山的洞穴里。用十字形的爪子钩住墙壁和洞顶爬来爬去。

description.en: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
description.zh_cn: 据说用特殊的冰山、岩石和熔岩制作出了形似自己的宝可梦。

description.en: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
description.zh_cn: 据说栖息在位于这个世界背面的毁坏的世界里。那里所有的常规都与这个世界不同。

description.en: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.zh_cn: 飞行的时候，会从薄纱一样的翅膀中发出闪光粒子。被称为新月的化身。

description.en: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
description.zh_cn: 如果海水的温度上升，该宝可梦就会让头部的浮囊膨胀起来，然后集体在海面上漂浮。

description.en: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 如果使用与生俱来的神奇力量，就可以和任何宝可梦心意相通。

description.en: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
description.zh_cn: 用能引诱对方进入深度睡眠的力量，让人和宝可梦做恶梦，并将其驱逐出自己的领地。

description.en: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
description.zh_cn: 拥有分解大气中的毒素，让荒芜大地瞬间变成花圃的力量。

description.en: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
description.zh_cn: 神奥神话里说，它从蛋中现身，并创造出了整个世界。

description.en: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description.zh_cn: 是会带来胜利的宝可梦。据说带着比克提尼的训练家会赢得任何对战。

description.en: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
description.zh_cn: 如果沐浴在阳光下，就能比平时动作迅速。比起手，藤蔓用得更灵活。

description.en: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description.zh_cn: 像滑行一样在地面奔跑。用敏捷的动作迷惑敌人，然后用藤鞭了结。

description.en: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.
description.zh_cn: 君主蛇只会对那些即使被它高贵的眼眸盯着，也毫不畏惧的强大对手动真格。

description.en: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description.zh_cn: 可以轻巧地躲避敌人的攻击，从鼻子里射出火球来。会用火烤树果吃。

description.en: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
description.zh_cn: 吃得越多，可供燃烧的东西就越多，胃里的火会增强，力量也会源源不断地溢出。

description.en: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description.zh_cn: 用下颚的火焰燃烧拳头，连续使出火焰拳。是对伙伴非常体贴的宝可梦。

description.en: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
description.zh_cn: 腹部长出的扇贝贝不只是战斗时使用，还能用来割开坚硬的树果。

description.en: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description.zh_cn: 通过严格的修炼，将使用２片扇贝贝的刀法运用得行云流水。

description.en: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
description.zh_cn: 能在敌人眨眼的瞬间，用前脚上带有的双足刃切斩对手，然后将其收回。

description.en: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description.zh_cn: 会在颊囊里藏食物，连续放哨好几天。用尾巴给伙伴发出暗号。

description.en: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
description.zh_cn: 用体内的发光物质让眼珠和身体闪闪发光，使来袭的敌人畏缩。

description.en: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.
description.zh_cn: 是拥有优秀判断力的宝可梦。如果判断出自己无法战胜对手，就会立即夹着尾巴逃走。

description.en: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.
description.zh_cn: 黑色的体毛会随着成长而变得坚硬结实，连爪子和牙齿也不能轻易穿透。

description.en: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.
description.zh_cn: 多亏了那身又长又暖和的毛，抵御寒冷根本不在话下。阿罗拉的长毛狗看上去有点辛苦。

description.en: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
description.zh_cn: 用可爱的动作让对手疏忽，抓住那个空当抢夺持有物。一旦生气，就会竖起爪子反击。

description.en: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
description.zh_cn: 优美的身姿归功于全身发达的肌肉。能悄无声息地在夜间飞奔。

description.en: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
description.zh_cn: 会把头上的叶子分给没有精神的宝可梦。具有缓解疲劳的效果。

description.en: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
description.zh_cn: 用带有很多尖刺的尾巴摔打对手进行攻击。是性格很粗暴的宝可梦。

description.en: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
description.zh_cn: 智商很高，有着将树果烤熟后再吃的习性。很喜爱给人类帮忙。

description.en: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
description.zh_cn: 燃烧体内的火焰，从头和尾巴纷纷扬扬地撒出火花，把敌人都烧焦。

description.en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
description.zh_cn: 头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了营养。会用尾巴给草木浇这种水。

description.en: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
description.zh_cn: 如果从尾巴发射出高压水，那威力甚至能破坏混凝土墙壁。

description.en: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
description.zh_cn: 会出现在为恶梦所苦的宝可梦和人的面前，吃掉那个恶梦。

description.en: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 从额头冒出的烟雾里载满许许多多的人和宝可梦做的梦。

description.en: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
description.zh_cn: 非常健忘的宝可梦。明明训练家已经下了命令，却还在等待着新命令。

description.en: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
description.zh_cn: 人们相信，咕咕鸽所居住的森林深处有着没有战争的和平国度。

description.en: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.zh_cn: 雄性会摇晃头上的冠羽威吓对手。雌性的飞行能力在雄性之上。

description.en: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
description.zh_cn: 天空雷雨云密布时就会出现。用鬃毛捕捉雷电，储存电力。

description.en: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
description.zh_cn: 性格粗暴的宝可梦。如果发脾气，就会从鬃毛里向着四面八方放电。

description.en: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!
description.zh_cn: 六角形的洞是它的耳朵。耳朵里面有能量核心，所以如果把手伸进去就会发怒。

description.en: The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.
description.zh_cn: 从身体里溢出的能量变成了橙色的结晶。其硬度连钻石都能弄碎。

description.en: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.
description.zh_cn: 如果以全力射出能量，那力量能让它自己的身体骤然产生出无数裂缝。

description.en: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description.zh_cn: 生活在昏暗的森林和洞穴中。从鼻孔里发出超音波探查周边的情形。

description.en: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
description.zh_cn: 发出连混凝土都能破坏的强力超音波时，尾巴会激烈地振动。

description.en: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
description.zh_cn: 将双掌上的爪子并拢，并让身体高速旋转的话，就会以迅猛的速度在地里前进。

description.en: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description.zh_cn: 进化成钢的钻头拥有穿透铁板的破坏力。在隧道工程里非常活跃。

description.en: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
description.zh_cn: 通过耳朵上的触角，能了解对方的身体状况，甚至连宝可梦何时从蛋里孵出来都能知道。

description.en: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
description.zh_cn: 总是抱着方材。是会出现在建筑工地帮忙干活的宝可梦。

description.en: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
description.zh_cn: 肌肉锻炼得很棒。能够灵巧地操纵工字钢，将整座屋子拆除。

description.en: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description.zh_cn: 制作混凝土的技术，被认为是２０００年前从修建老匠那儿学来的。

description.en: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
description.zh_cn: 振动脸颊上的振动膜，发出人类无法听见的音波向伙伴们传递危险警告。

description.en: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description.zh_cn: 如果让头上的瘤振动，不只是水里泛起波浪，连地面也会像地震一样摇晃。

description.en: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
description.zh_cn: 如果让拳头上的瘤振动，拳击的威力就会倍增。能一拳把巨大岩石击得粉碎。

description.en: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description.zh_cn: 如果系紧带子，力量就会提升。野生的投摔鬼会编织藤蔓做成自己的带子。

description.en: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
description.zh_cn: 因追求最强的空手劈而隐居在深山里，不眠不休地修行。

description.en: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
description.zh_cn: 咬断叶子，用嘴里吐出的粘丝进行缝合。是会自己做衣服的宝可梦。

description.en: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description.zh_cn: 宝包茧会把落叶转换成养分，所以它居住的森林总是草木繁茂。

description.en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
description.zh_cn: 如果发现幼小的宝可梦，就会用嘴里吐出的粘丝为它缝制叶子衣服。

description.en: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
description.zh_cn: 用头和尾巴上的触角探查周围的情形。性格非常粗暴。

description.en: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description.zh_cn: 被坚硬的壳保护着。像轮胎那样地旋转，猛烈地撞击敌人。

description.en: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
description.zh_cn: 用颈部的爪子夹住猎物，让对方动弹不得之后，施以剧毒，一击毙命。

description.en: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.
description.zh_cn: 会喷出棉花保护身体。如果淋到雨，棉花就会受潮变重，身体变得动弹不得。

description.en: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.
description.zh_cn: 潜入民居，藏起重要的东西，或是在屋子里到处撒棉花，是个捣蛋的家伙。

description.en: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.
description.zh_cn: 如果利用阳光晒干它头上的叶子，再煎煮后饮用，会马上变得有活力，在老年人中很受欢迎。

description.en: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
description.zh_cn: 根据栽培土壤的成分不同，花香也会略微不一样。闻一下就能治愈心灵，心情舒畅。

description.en: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
description.zh_cn: 是性格粗暴又凶猛的宝可梦。红色和蓝色的野蛮鲈鱼总是为了领地问题打架。

description.en: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.
description.zh_cn: 对它来说，全年温暖的阿罗拉是很容易生活的环境。即使在沙漠以外也时常能见到。

description.en: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.
description.zh_cn: 非常害怕身体变冷。在气温下降的夜晚会潜藏在沙漠的沙子深处。

description.en: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
description.zh_cn: 如果发现前方５０公里处的猎物，就会像游泳一样在沙漠里移动，扑过去咬住。

description.en: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
description.zh_cn: 火红不倒翁的粪便是热的，因此过去的人们会放入怀中取暖。

description.en: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
description.zh_cn: 如果在激烈的战斗中受伤，就会像岩石一样一动不动，沉思着磨炼自己的心智。

description.en: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description.zh_cn: 对于那些以花的种子为目标的天敌鸟宝可梦，会用节奏轻快的舞蹈和音乐来驱赶。

description.en: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
description.zh_cn: 在合适的石头上开洞作为住所。如果被破坏，在找到替代的石头之前会一直心里不踏实。

description.en: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
description.zh_cn: 脚力非常的好，身上背负着很重的岩石，还能在干燥的土地上移动多日。

description.en: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
description.zh_cn: 几只为一组行动。漫无目的地到处走，会冷不丁地向视线相遇的对手施以头锤。

description.en: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
description.zh_cn: 性格粗鲁，但是对于自己的家族、群体的伙伴和领地，非常重视。

description.en: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
description.zh_cn: 曾是古代都市的守护神。用精神力量攻击入侵领地的敌人。

description.en: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
description.zh_cn: 埋葬在墓穴里的人类灵魂变化而成的宝可梦。还残留着死前的记忆。

description.en: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description.zh_cn: 有传言说，它会吞掉接近它的人类，做成木乃伊。喜欢吃金块。

description.en: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.
description.zh_cn: 由古代的化石复活而来。曾生活在海里，但也会到陆地上来寻找猎物。

description.en: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.
description.zh_cn: 颚部的力量非常惊人。连多刺菊石兽和菊石兽的壳也能轻轻松松地整个吃掉。

description.en: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.
description.zh_cn: 被认为是所有鸟宝可梦的祖先，但最近的研究里也有说法认为这个是错误的。

description.en: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.
description.zh_cn: 古代的宝可梦。因为羽毛很细，所以如果不是熟练的匠人，就会复原失败。

description.en: Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.
description.zh_cn: 呼吸的时候会有毒瓦斯漏出。臭臭泥闻到气味就会流着口水赶过来。

description.en: It locks opponents in place with its left hand, immobilizing them by entirely dousing their bodies with poisonous liquid.
description.zh_cn: 用左臂锁住敌人后，会将有毒的液体泼向对方全身，封住其行动。

description.en: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it's not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
description.zh_cn: 性格胆小的宝可梦，不和伙伴呆在一起的时候，通常都会幻化成其他东西。

description.en: It doesn't just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
description.zh_cn: 不只是幻化成其他东西，还拥有让几百人看见幻像的力量。

description.en: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
description.zh_cn: 因为有洁癖，所以不能容忍一丁点儿的脏污。会把尾巴当做拖把彻底地清除脏污。

description.en: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies' attacks.
description.zh_cn: 白色的毛发上涂满身体里渗出的油，连敌人的攻击也能滑溜溜地避开。

description.en: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description.zh_cn: 用蝴蝶结一样的触角让精神力量增强。一直都目不转睛地盯着什么。

description.en: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
description.zh_cn: 星光是其力量的来源。到了夜里就会用精神力量让石头浮起，按星星的分布排列。

description.en: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description.zh_cn: 受强大的精神力量的影响，哥德小姐周围的空间会扭曲，数万光年之外的星空也能映照出来。

description.en: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.
description.zh_cn: 身体被特殊的液体包裹着，所以无论多么严峻的情况都能平安无事。

description.en: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description.zh_cn: 因为有着一分为二的大脑，所以有时会突然采取不同的行动。

description.en: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
description.zh_cn: 使用发出的精神力量，操纵特殊液体做成的手臂将岩石击碎。

description.en: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
description.zh_cn: 如果被敌人袭击，就会从全身的羽毛里喷出水花。混在一片水雾中逃之夭夭。

description.en: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
description.zh_cn: 尽管有着优雅的外表，挥动翅膀时却很用力，可以连续飞行几千公里。

description.en: It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit. When it's in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.
description.zh_cn: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气。如果呆在温暖的场所，就会一点点地变小。

description.en: It sprays its enemies with grains of ice to freeze them. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.
description.zh_cn: 喷出冰粒，冻住敌人的身体。阿罗拉的多多冰整体都是小型的。

description.en: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.
description.zh_cn: 从２张嘴里喷出暴风雪。无论在哪里都能制作出雪来，所以很受滑雪和滑雪板爱好者欢迎。

description.en: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
description.zh_cn: 不只是换季时，即使是气温和湿度的变化，身体颜色也会有稍稍改变。

description.en: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.
description.zh_cn: 会根据季节改变住所。人们会通过萌芽鹿的角来感知季节的变迁。

description.en: They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.
description.zh_cn: 蓄着电在空中飞行。有时甚至会在雷鸣的深夜里，密密麻麻布满整个天空。

description.en: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description.zh_cn: 与小嘴蜗在一起时，如果受到电的刺激就会进化的神奇宝可梦。

description.en: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
description.zh_cn: 用从小嘴蜗那里抢来的壳盖住自己的身体，一边防守一边用２根长矛突刺。

description.en: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description.zh_cn: 以酷似精灵球的花纹引诱对手并向其喷出毒孢子。为何那么像还是一个谜。

description.en: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
description.zh_cn: 显摆着精灵球状的菌伞引诱猎物靠近，但是被骗到的宝可梦很少。

description.en: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
description.zh_cn: 会用薄纱般的手脚缠住正在游泳的猎物，将其拖入深海之中。

description.en: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
description.zh_cn: 会缠着豪华客轮或是油轮周围，目的是将猎物拖进海里。

description.en: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there'll be no need for a doctor or medicine.
description.zh_cn: 渔夫在长距离航海时会带着它。因为有了保姆曼波，医生和药都不需要了。

description.en: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
description.zh_cn: 因为自己不能制造电，所以会附在其它大型宝可梦身上吸取静电。

description.en: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
description.zh_cn: 会用带电的丝设下陷阱。会慢慢地享用触电后无法动弹的猎物。

description.en: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description.zh_cn: 察觉到危险的同时会发射尖刺反击。然后趁机翻滚着逃跑。

description.en: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
description.zh_cn: 挥打３根触手，然后射出尖刺，将对手粉碎，不留痕迹。

description.en: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
description.zh_cn: 通过２个身体的咬合旋转，制造出用以生存的能量。

description.en: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description.zh_cn: 通过改变旋转的方向来向伙伴传递感情。越是生气，旋转得就越快。

description.en: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
description.zh_cn: 让带有红色核心的齿轮高速旋转，便能快速填充能量。

description.en: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description.zh_cn: １条的电力虽小，但是许多麻麻小鱼聚在一起，其威力可以比得上雷电。

description.en: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
description.zh_cn: 缠住对手，从圆圆的斑点放出电流通过对方身体，使其麻痹后啃食。

description.en: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
description.zh_cn: 用吸盘一样的嘴巴吸住猎物，并从刺入的牙齿中释放电流，使对方触电。

description.en: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
description.zh_cn: 操纵着非常惊人的精神力量。大多数目击外星人的信息都是错把小灰怪看成外星人了。

description.en: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
description.zh_cn: 会用精神力量改写对手的记忆。你说不定也已经被改写了。

description.en: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
description.zh_cn: 假装点亮烛光，指引道路，实际上是在吸取对方的生命力。

description.en: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
description.zh_cn: 吸取灵魂来点亮灯火。为了等待人类死去，而在医院里彷徨游荡。

description.en: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
description.zh_cn: 如果被水晶灯火灵的火焰包围，魂魄就会被吸取燃烧。只剩下行尸走肉。

description.en: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description.zh_cn: 用牙齿粉碎树果后食用。牙齿会通过多次再生，变得无比强劲锐利。

description.en: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
description.zh_cn: 拥有能粉碎巨大岩石的牙齿。争夺领地的斧牙龙们会进行非常激烈的争斗。

description.en: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description.zh_cn: 性格温和，但对于入侵领地者绝不会手软。会用削铁如泥的牙齿发起挑战。

description.en: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
description.zh_cn: 总是流着鼻涕。吸着鼻涕使出招式。鼻涕是招式的本源。

description.en: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢北方冰冷的大海。将嘴里吐出的气息冻结，在海上铺成道路来行走。

description.en: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
description.zh_cn: 在雪云之中诞生。用冰的结晶所形成的锁捕捉猎物。

description.en: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
description.zh_cn: 与盖盖虫在一起时，如果受到电的刺激，双方的身体就会进化。

description.en: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
description.zh_cn: 因为脱掉了沉重的壳，而变得轻巧。会用简直是忍者般的身手战斗。

description.en: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description.zh_cn: 皮肤坚硬，所以即使被相扑力士踩踏也照样淡定自如。释放电流时，会喜笑颜开。

description.en: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
description.zh_cn: 可以在早上看到用慢悠悠的动作摆出各种姿势的群体哦。

description.en: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
description.zh_cn: 会用连续攻击压倒对手。致命的一击会在缓慢蓄力后施展出来。

description.en: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
description.zh_cn: 红色脸孔上的皮肤比岩石还要硬。在狭窄的洞窟中，会用脸朝向敌人发动突击。

description.en: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
description.zh_cn: 因谜一般的能量而活动。因为从古代开始就持续活动，说不定很快就会用尽力量。

description.en: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.
description.zh_cn: 据说，古代人发明了泥偶巨人作为他们的劳动力。它很忠实于主人的命令。

description.en: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
description.zh_cn: 在劈开猎物后，会用河滩的石头将刀刃磨快。不同的驹刀小兵都有各自喜欢的石头。

description.en: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
description.zh_cn: 据说，无论是多么强大的劈斩司令，一旦头部的刀刃有损伤，就会从首领的位置上引退。

description.en: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
description.zh_cn: 一往无前地猛冲，使出头锤。拥有让奔跑的列车脱轨的破坏力。

description.en: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.
description.zh_cn: 用强大的脚力和结实的爪子，连大舌贝的坚硬外壳都能弄碎，将里面的东西啄出来。

description.en: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.
description.zh_cn: 正面伤越多，就表示越勇敢，而背面受伤多的则会在群体中受到轻视。

description.en: Mandibuzz gives it the bones it wears. Vullaby's wings are short, so it can't fly yet, but it jumps around, dreaming of wide open skies.
description.zh_cn: 骸骨是秃鹰娜所给予的。翅膀很短，还不会飞，但是一直憧憬着天空而蹦蹦跳跳的。

description.en: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
description.zh_cn: 会使用所吃猎物的骨头灵巧地做成自己的巢穴。大多数骨头都是卡拉卡拉的。

description.en: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.
description.zh_cn: 用高温燃烧的火焰舌头熔化铁蚁的钢铁身体，并吃掉其内部。

description.en: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
description.zh_cn: 面对天敌熔蚁兽时，大家会分工合作进行反击，把它从巢穴中驱赶出去。

description.en: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
description.zh_cn: 因为眼睛看不见，所以会又撞又咬地来探索周围。浑身新伤不断。

description.en: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
description.zh_cn: ２个头之间关系恶劣，都想比对方吃得更多来掌握主导权。

description.en: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
description.zh_cn: 双臂上的头是没有大脑的。用３个头把一切都吃光并破坏掉。

description.en: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.zh_cn: 从５只角中喷出火焰与对手战斗。那温度最高可达３０００度。

description.en: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as "the rage of the sun."
description.zh_cn: 一边挥撒火焰鳞粉一边到处飞翔。古代的人们惧怕地称之为太阳的怒火。

description.en: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
description.zh_cn: 拥有钢铁的身体和心灵。只要瞪一眼，连粗暴的宝可梦也会俯首称臣。

description.en: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
description.zh_cn: 拥有一击冲破巨大城墙的猛撞力。是传说中所描述的宝可梦。

description.en: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
description.zh_cn: 头上的角是锋利的刀刃。用旋风般的动作戏弄敌人，迅速切斩。

description.en: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
description.zh_cn: 下半身被云一样的能量体包裹着。以３００公里的时速在空中飞行。

description.en: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
description.zh_cn: 用尾巴上的尖刺射电攻击。在合众地区的天空飞来飞去制造雷电。

description.en: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
description.zh_cn: 用火焰让世界燃烧殆尽的传说的宝可梦。会帮助构筑真实世界的人。

description.en: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.
description.zh_cn: 用闪电让世界燃烧殆尽的传说的宝可梦。会辅佐创造理想世界的人。

description.en: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."
description.zh_cn: 土地云造访的土地，作物收成必定大好，因此被称为农田之神。

description.en: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
description.zh_cn: 等待着用真实与理想填补自己失去的身体的英雄，是冰之传说的宝可梦。

description.en: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
description.zh_cn: 在江河湖海的水面奔跑，驰骋全世界。会出现在美丽的水边。

description.en: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
description.zh_cn: 美洛耶塔演奏的旋律拥有让周围的宝可梦或悲或喜的力量。

description.en: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
description.zh_cn: 被等离子队改造过的古代的虫宝可梦。背上的大炮力量得到了提升。

description.en: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description.zh_cn: 头部的刺平时很柔软，如果注入了力量，就会变尖锐，硬得连岩石也能刺穿。

description.en: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description.zh_cn: 覆盖着身体的结实外壳能反弹敌人的攻击，会用锐利的刺反击。

description.en: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description.zh_cn: 有着用身体撞击来弄翻５０吨重坦克的力量。会把自己当作护盾来保护伙伴。

description.en: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.zh_cn: 吃小树枝后就会变得充满活力，会从大大的耳朵里喷出超过摄氏２００度的热气。

description.en: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description.zh_cn: 尾巴上插着树枝。通过尾巴上的毛摩擦生热，点燃树枝来战斗。

description.en: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description.zh_cn: 盯着木杖前端燃烧着的火焰，集中精神的话，就能看透未来发生之事。

description.en: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description.zh_cn: 从胸部和背部发出泡泡。用具有弹力的泡泡抵挡攻击，减少伤害。

description.en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description.zh_cn: 使用投掷被泡泡包着的小石头的招式。控制力很强，可以击中３０米外的空罐子。

description.en: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description.zh_cn: 压缩水，制造出手里剑。让它高速旋转后飞出的话，连金属也能一劈两半。

description.en: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description.zh_cn: 用大大的耳朵挖掘地面制造巢穴。可以整晚不休息连续不停地挖。

description.en: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description.zh_cn: 大大的耳朵拥有轻松举起超过１吨重的岩石的力量。在施工现场非常活跃。

description.en: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.
description.zh_cn: 是和人很亲近的宝可梦，但如果强行触碰，它就会让身体一下子发热，从而造成灼伤。

description.en: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
description.zh_cn: 向草丛挥撒火花。然后大口吞食被火焰吓到从草丛跳出来的虫宝可梦。

description.en: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
description.zh_cn: 羽毛很结实，连火都烧不穿。过去的消防员服就是用烈箭鹰的羽毛做成的。

description.en: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description.zh_cn: 如果被鸟宝可梦袭击，就会挥撒黑色的粉。是一旦接触就会麻痹的毒粉。

description.en: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description.zh_cn: 隐藏在繁茂的树荫中生活。一旦被敌人袭击，就会尖尖地竖起体毛威吓对方。

description.en: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description.zh_cn: 世界上有着各种各样翅膀花纹的彩粉蝶。好像是受所居住土地的气候影响。

description.en: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.
description.zh_cn: 小时候会与伙伴们群居生活。一旦自己能捕猎后，就会被赶出群体独立生活。

description.en: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
description.zh_cn: 雄性平时总是拖拖拉拉的，但如果有强敌来袭，就会不顾自身，保护伙伴。

description.en: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
description.zh_cn: 如果没有花的力量，就会很危险。但是在找到喜爱的颜色和形状之前，会不断地旅行。

description.en: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
description.zh_cn: 会培育花朵当作自己的武器来用。越是开得美丽的花，蕴藏着的力量就越强大。

description.en: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
description.zh_cn: 会操纵自己培育的花。花洁夫人释放的落英缤纷，其美貌和力量都是压倒性的。

description.en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description.zh_cn: 据说是最早能够和人一起生活的宝可梦。性格很温和。

description.en: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description.zh_cn: 从握角的细微差异就能读取训练家的心情，所以会心灵一体奔跑。

description.en: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.
description.zh_cn: 像跟班那样跟在流氓熊猫后头。如果犯了重大错误，叶子就会被拿走。

description.en: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
description.zh_cn: 以腕力为傲的野性的宝可梦。性格豪爽，因此迷恋它的训练家也很多。

description.en: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou's fur into the most exquisite style.
description.zh_cn: 曾有过一个时代，贵族之间会比赛如何把它的体毛修剪得美丽。

description.en: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description.zh_cn: 为了不让强大的精神力量漏出，用耳朵捂住释放力量的器官。

description.en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.zh_cn: 如果危险逼近，就会竖起耳朵，释放出能拧碎１０吨重卡车的精神力量。

description.en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description.zh_cn: 好像是死者的灵魂寄宿在古剑上转生而成。会附在人类身上吸食生命。

description.en: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description.zh_cn: 进化后分裂为２把。通过心灵感应对话，用配合攻击砍碎敌人。

description.en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 曾跟随着历代国王。用灵力控制人和宝可梦的心，使之服从。

description.en: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description.zh_cn: 从身体里飘出令闻者神魂颠倒的香气。香气会因所吃的食物而改变。

description.en: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description.zh_cn: 制作出各种各样的气味。发出对手讨厌的气味，让战斗朝对自己有利的方向推进。

description.en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description.zh_cn: 放出像棉花糖那样又甜又黏的白丝缠住对手，封住其行动。

description.en: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description.zh_cn: 拥有即便是细微气味也能区分的敏锐嗅觉，是西点师傅的好帮手。

description.en: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.
description.zh_cn: 闪烁着光，让猎物受诱惑靠近后，会用长长的触手缠住对方，封住其行动。

description.en: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.
description.zh_cn: 会使用强力的催眠术。用此来做坏事者源源不断。

description.en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description.zh_cn: ２只龟脚脚生活在一块岩石上。如果吵架了，就会有某只转移到其他岩石上去。

description.en: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description.zh_cn: 进化的时候，２只龟脚脚会分裂为７只的宝可梦。会以７只的力量战斗。

description.en: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.
description.zh_cn: 同碎藻混杂在一起，为了不被大型宝可梦袭击，一直一动不动的。以腐烂的海藻为主要食物。

description.en: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.
description.zh_cn: 性格粗暴，会朝靠近的对手喷出毒液。不知为何，只和破破舵轮关系非常好。

description.en: Its claws occasionally fall off, and it keeps a low profile until they grow back. The meat of its claws is so delicious!
description.zh_cn: 钳子时常会掉落，在再生之前，会悄悄地生活。钳子里面的肉非常美味哦。

description.en: It compresses the water it has sucked up and then projects it with enough power to punch a hole right through a thick sheet of iron.
description.zh_cn: 压缩吸入的水，然后射出去。那威力连很厚的铁板都能打穿一个洞。

description.en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description.zh_cn: 在沙漠生活。只要能沐浴着阳光发电，即使不吃食物也安然无恙。

description.en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description.zh_cn: 会张开颈伞发电。１只光电伞蜥就能制造出一栋高层建筑所必需的电。

description.en: Its large jaw has incredible destructive power. Some theories suggest that its restored form is different from its form of long ago.
description.zh_cn: 大颚有着非常惊人的破坏力。有说法，即使复原，也没法恢复到原本的样子。

description.en: Complete restoration is impossible, allowing room for theories that its entire body was once covered in a feather-like coat.
description.zh_cn: 有说法，要完全复原是不可能的，实际上它全身都是羽毛一样的毛发。

description.en: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It's said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.
description.zh_cn: 曾栖息在古代寒冷的土地上。据说，冰雪龙鸣叫的时候，夜空中会出现极光。

description.en: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.
description.zh_cn: 报道里说，在冰山中发现了被冻住的冰雪巨龙，仍保持着当时的样子。

description.en: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.
description.zh_cn: 一旦进入战斗状态，即使面对比自己大几倍的龙宝可梦，也会毫不畏惧地飞扑过去。

description.en: It overwhelms opponents with quick moves, but sometimes it showboats for too long when it's using a special move and gets itself into a pinch.
description.zh_cn: 用速度快的招式压倒对手。使出必杀技时的展示时间过长，有时候会陷入危机。

description.en: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.
description.zh_cn: 潜入民居，从插座里偷电。电费很奇怪的时候，就是这家伙的杰作。

description.en: Some say that deep beneath the surface of the world, a pack of Carbink live with their queen in a kingdom of jewels.
description.zh_cn: 据说，在地底的深处，有着小碎钻群体和它们的女王共同生活的宝石王国。

description.en: It uses its horns to check out its surroundings. They're very sensitive, so if you grab them, it will feel a strong shock and be unable to move.
description.zh_cn: 用角探索周围的情况。非常敏感，所以只要被握住，就会因震惊而无法动弹。

description.en: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.
description.zh_cn: 慢吞吞地爬行移动。旋涡状的突起里装着大脑和内脏。

description.en: It's very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don't get mad.
description.zh_cn: 和人非常亲近。变得亲密后，会用被黏糊糊的黏液包裹着的身体抱住人的身体，要忍耐哦。

description.en: Although it's unclear why it collects keys, giving it a key makes Klefki very happy. However, it apparently only likes master keys.
description.zh_cn: 不知为何要收集钥匙，但如果给它的话，就会很高兴。不过好像不是万能钥匙就不喜欢。

description.en: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.
description.zh_cn: 会模拟孩子的声音将人引入森林的深处让其迷失。因为打算让对方做自己的伙伴。

description.en: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.
description.zh_cn: 人们惧怕它，认为它是森林的妖怪。樵夫们会带着朽木妖讨厌的火属性宝可梦再进入森林。

description.en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.zh_cn: 南瓜的身体里有无法往生的灵魂。黄昏到来便开始活动。

description.en: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description.zh_cn: 在朔月的夜晚一边在街上游荡一边用诡异的声音唱歌。如果听到那歌声，就会被诅咒。

description.en: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
description.zh_cn: 覆盖着身体的冰可以抵御敌人的攻击。即使被打破也能立即用冷气结起冰。

description.en: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
description.zh_cn: 冻住的身体像钢铁一样坚硬。用巨大身躯压碎挡道的东西移动。

description.en: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢吃水果。会用超音波击中水果，然后只挑选出已成熟的来食用，是个美食家。

description.en: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.
description.zh_cn: 性格粗暴，但如果给它喜爱吃的成熟水果，就会一反常态，变得很亲切。

description.en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.zh_cn: 据说，能够分享出永恒的生命。以树木的样子睡了１０００年后复活。

description.en: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description.zh_cn: 展开翅膀和尾羽，闪着红色光芒时，就会吸取生物的生命，是传说的宝可梦。

description.en: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.
description.zh_cn: 基格尔德的一部分大约聚集了一半的样子。有着监视生态系统的职责。

description.en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.zh_cn: 小碎钻的突变体。闪着粉红色光辉的身体被赞为全世界最美。

description.en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description.zh_cn: 用扭曲空间的圆环把所有东西都击飞到远处的麻烦制造者。

description.en: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description.zh_cn: 喷出水蒸气，用浓雾隐藏自己。据说住在人类不会进入的山里。

description.en: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.
description.zh_cn: 射出像刀刃般锐利的羽毛进行攻击。脚上的力量也很强，脚踢也不可小觑。

description.en: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.
description.zh_cn: 非常自恋，又爱美。如果不勤快地给它打理，或许会不听话。

description.en: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.
description.zh_cn: 会搭上箭羽射向对手。在绝对不想射偏时，会拉紧头上的藤蔓集中精神。

description.en: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
description.zh_cn: 如果被纠缠不休，就不会再打开心扉。即使亲近起来，过多的亲密接触也是禁忌。

description.en: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.
description.zh_cn: 如果亲近了，也会对训练家撒娇，但是力量很强，爪子也很锋利，所以会被弄得全身是伤。

description.en: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.
description.zh_cn: 性格暴躁又任性，但讨厌欺凌弱小这类无聊的事。对于强大的对手会拿出干劲来。

description.en: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
description.zh_cn: 通过每天不断地重复练习，用鼻子吹起来的气球一点点地变大起来。

description.en: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.
description.zh_cn: 如果看到没见过的舞蹈，就会很兴奋。会拼命练习直到自己也会跳为止。是个很努力的家伙哦。

description.en: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
description.zh_cn: 对于西狮海壬来说，战斗就是舞台。华丽地唱着歌跳着舞，给猎物致命一击。

description.en: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
description.zh_cn: 会用坚硬的鸟嘴啄树木。通过啄击的节奏，大致就能知道它当时的心情和身体状况。

description.en: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
description.zh_cn: 嘟起鸟嘴的嘴尖，可以自由地叫出１００种以上的声音。

description.en: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
description.zh_cn: 与伙伴互相敲击鸟嘴进行交流。通过敲击的强度和次数来互相传达心情。

description.en: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
description.zh_cn: 长长的躯体里面基本都是胃。因为食量很大，伙食费不可小觑。

description.en: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
description.zh_cn: 原本在阿罗拉是没有的，但过去小拉达大量出现的时候被带了过来。

description.en: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.
description.zh_cn: 即使发现了它的巢穴，也不能贸然把手伸进去。会被强颚鸡母虫厌烦而咬住。

description.en: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!
description.zh_cn: 埋在落叶里一动不动，专心致志地吃着腐叶土。如果不小心错踩到它，就会被电到。

description.en: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
description.zh_cn: 腹部拥有发电器官。在大颚里收集能量，释放出惊人的电击。

description.en: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
description.zh_cn: 坚硬的钳子攻守皆宜。好胜蟹同类之间的战斗就像是拳击一样。

description.en: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
description.zh_cn: 在钳子中积蓄冷气，然后猛殴。即使是很厚的冰壁也能打得粉碎。

description.en: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
description.zh_cn: 用热情的舞蹈抓住敌人的心，趁对方疏忽的间隙，用熊熊燃烧的火焰将其烧尽。

description.en: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.
description.zh_cn: 喜欢吃花蜜和花粉。会在花圃里寻找食物，和巴大蝶展开小冲突。

description.en: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.
description.zh_cn: 因为花粉会湿，所以讨厌下雨。如果开始阴云密布了，就会静静地躲在树洞里不行动。

description.en: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
description.zh_cn: 随着成长，性格也会变得粗暴而有攻击性。因难以应付而丢弃它的训练家也不少。

description.en: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
description.zh_cn: 鬃毛里的岩石像刀子一样锋利。会对猎物穷追不舍，待其慢慢虚弱后再给予致命一击。

description.en: They're weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
description.zh_cn: 因为很弱小，所以会群体行动。但也经常能见到走散后独自１只在游泳的样子。

description.en: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.
description.zh_cn: 因为它会吃太阳珊瑚的枝，所以被收集自然掉落的枝来加工的匠人们所厌恶。

description.en: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.
description.zh_cn: 会射出有剧毒的尖刺攻击敌人。用脚上的爪子扫平靠近的对手。

description.en: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.
description.zh_cn: 非常喜欢玩泥巴。如果不每天在泥巴里玩的话，就会因压力而不听话。

description.en: It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.
description.zh_cn: 无论发生什么都不会动，非常好静。把嘴里含着的土和唾液混合，制作成特殊的泥。

description.en: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.
description.zh_cn: 如果滴蛛同类之间相遇，它们会自豪地用头上的水泡炫耀。水泡小的一方就会让路。

description.en: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
description.zh_cn: 平常就是水里生活。肚子饱的时候，会把抓获的猎物收纳在头部的水泡里。

description.en: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.
description.zh_cn: 太阳升起后，就会展开４片叶子进行日光浴。会从头顶发出好闻的味道哦。

description.en: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
description.zh_cn: 为了保护自己而伪装成虫宝可梦。双臂的花瓣非常锋利。

description.en: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.
description.zh_cn: 在周围到处撒发光的孢子。虽然危险，但去睡睡菇居住的森林进行夜巡很受人们欢迎。

description.en: It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.
description.zh_cn: 让猎物睡着，然后从手腕处夺走对方的生命气息。伙伴虚弱的话，就会输送生命气息给予拯救。

description.en: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.
description.zh_cn: 雄性基本对雌性唯命是从。获得的食物也基本都会上缴，所以因营养不足而无法进化。

description.en: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
description.zh_cn: 居住在洞窟的深处，让那些因费洛蒙而着迷的夜盗火蜥侍奉自己。

description.en: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.
description.zh_cn: 以连大树都能折断的力量而自豪。从臀部的器官发出气味，与伙伴进行交流。

description.en: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.
description.zh_cn: 大幅度地挥手是威吓和警戒的信号。一刻也不能耽误，不逃就没命了。

description.en: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.
description.zh_cn: 因为闻起来又甜又香的气味而被鸟宝可梦袭击，但是不太聪明，所以根本没在意。

description.en: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.
description.zh_cn: 因为被坚硬的壳盖保护着，所以和鸟宝可梦都能淡定地玩耍。就算反复被啄也不会在意。

description.en: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
description.zh_cn: 优美的脚踢招式的行家。就连搏击冠军也能用一招脚踢将对方击倒。

description.en: It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn't have any flowers, it feels uneasy.
description.zh_cn: 从头上伸出有粘性的藤蔓，用摘下的花朵装饰自己。没有花就会感到不安。

description.en: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.
description.zh_cn: 平常就在树上冥想着度日。会随意投掷精灵球，命令宝可梦。

description.en: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.
description.zh_cn: 使用唾液将叶片贴在肩上做标记。通过叶片的分布就能明白是哪个群体哦。

description.en: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.
description.zh_cn: 无论是什么掉落的东西，都会捡。因为有时候也会拿着硬币，所以会被黑暗鸦和喵喵袭击。

description.en: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.
description.zh_cn: 覆盖着身体的坚硬外壳拥有媲美钻石的强度。为了胜利会不择手段。

description.en: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.
description.zh_cn: 很喜欢头上的小铲子,会和回来拿的孩子打架。互相打着打着就当真了。

description.en: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.
description.zh_cn: 即使是一粒沙子也有思想。会吞下小型的宝可梦，活生生地夺走对方的生命气息。

description.en: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
description.zh_cn: 扔拳海参的文化始于将冲上岸的拳海参扔回海里这个习俗。

description.en: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.
description.zh_cn: 是为了某个任务而被开发出来的宝可梦武器。因为在试验中暴走而被冻结了。

description.en: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.
description.zh_cn: 觉醒进化后的样子。从沉重的面罩里被解放出来，速度大幅提升。

description.en: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在臭氧层，成为了更强大的宝可梦的食物。会在逃跑的过程中掉落到地上。

description.en: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
description.zh_cn: 出生后就一直都睡着。进入深度睡眠的时候，会变的一动也不动。

description.en: It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在火山，吃硫磺和矿物。所吃食物的成分会成为爆炸的甲壳的来源。

description.en: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
description.zh_cn: 背上的１４根针毛在受惊或是兴奋的时候会随意竖起来。

description.en: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.
description.zh_cn: 稳重又怕寂寞，但如果想要看它的破布里面，就会非常厌恶，激烈反抗。

description.en: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
description.zh_cn: 潜藏在沙子里，从头部的突起物里放射出精神力量。会边探查周围的情形边等待猎物。

description.en: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.
description.zh_cn: 如果和自己成为朋友的孩子被欺负，就会找到欺负他的那个孩子家，然后用火燃烧殆尽。

description.en: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.
description.zh_cn: 缠绕着绿色的海藻，抢夺并吸取生命气息。光喜欢吃吼鲸王那样的大型生物，会攻击它们。

description.en: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.
description.zh_cn: 用头部的鳞片砰砰砰地敲响岩石和地面，威吓对手。也会用声音和伙伴联络。

description.en: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.
description.zh_cn: 让鳞片互相敲击，发出声响。在节奏达到最高潮的时候发动袭击。

description.en: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.
description.zh_cn: 一招制住猎物，发出长嚎后，伙伴们祝福的金属音会从各个地方回荡起来。

description.en: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
description.zh_cn: 被称为守护神，但也会袭击破坏自己心情的人类和宝可梦，是性情凶悍的神。

description.en: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.
description.zh_cn: 会到处撒着闪闪发光的鳞粉，治愈人类和宝可梦的伤。是阿卡拉所供奉的守护神。

description.en: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
description.zh_cn: 被称为守护神，但拥有将视为敌人者彻底击溃的强悍。

description.en: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在浓雾深处而被人们敬畏着。是操纵着水的波尼的守护神。

description.en: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.
description.zh_cn: 那不可靠的气体状身体只要稍微有点风就会被吹走，但却总是完全不在意的样子。

description.en: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.
description.zh_cn: 太古时代支配着阿罗拉的国王，称之为星之茧，因为崇拜它而建造了祭坛。

description.en: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.
description.zh_cn: 打开了究极之洞的结果是，把异世界的能量和生命召唤到这个世界的事也时有发生。

description.en: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."
description.zh_cn: 在遥远过去的文献里，以邀引月亮之兽为名留下了记录。

description.en: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
description.zh_cn: 是被称为究极异兽的其他世界的生命体。被认为拥有强力的神经毒素。

description.en: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.zh_cn: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。

description.en: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
description.zh_cn: 栖息在其他世界的生命体。身体纤细柔软，但是看起来蕴藏着强大的力量。

description.en: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.zh_cn: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。

description.en: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
description.zh_cn: 是危险的究极异兽中的一种。从它巨大的双臂中检测出来很高的能量反应。

description.en: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
description.zh_cn: 从纸一样薄的身体上能感觉到像磨过的刀刃一般的锋利度。是一种究极异兽。

description.en: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
description.zh_cn: 在这个世界是异类，很危险，但在它原本栖息的世界，好像只是寻常能见的生物。

description.en: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.
description.zh_cn: 为了寻找作为能量的光而发狂的样子看上去有些痛苦。好像存在于其他世界。

description.en: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
description.zh_cn: 能够让意识同步，理解对方的心情。用来照料人的话是很方便的能力。

description.en: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.
description.zh_cn: 能潜入对方的影子，模仿对方的动作和力量。在模仿的过程中会变得比本尊更强。

description.en: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
description.zh_cn: 在异世界是亲切的究极异兽，甚至能被选为踏上旅程的同伴。

description.en: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
description.zh_cn: 体内储存着几百升的毒液。是被称为究极异兽的生物中的一种。

description.en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description.zh_cn: 从究极之洞里出现。好像是复数的生命累积起来，形成了１只。

description.en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description.zh_cn: 扭啊扭地移动着，靠近人后会突然让头爆炸。好像是究极异兽中的一种。

description.en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description.zh_cn: 让双手双脚的爪子带电，将对手撕得稀碎。即使被躲开，也会用飞散的电击让其触电。

description.en: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
description.zh_cn: 身体很薄，会一直贴在墙上。它的外形好像有着某种含义。

description.en: This is the form Castform takes on bright days. In an experiment where Castform was placed in front of a heater, it didn't change to this form.
description.zh_cn: 天气晴朗时飘浮泡泡的样子。在将它放到取暖器前的实验里，没有变成这个形态。

description.en: Castform changes to this form when rain hits it. Its body is soft and slightly swollen with water.
description.zh_cn: 被雨淋到后，就会变成这个样子。身体遇水会稍稍有点膨胀，软绵绵的。

description.en: This is the form Castform takes when hit by hail. In an experiment where it was placed in a freezer, it didn't change to this form.
description.zh_cn: 被冰雹打到时飘浮泡泡的样子。在将它放入冷冻库的实验里，没有变成这个形态。

description.en: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 附着在陨石上的宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ变异后生成的宝可梦。

description.en: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 附着在陨石上的宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ变异后生成的宝可梦。

description.en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.zh_cn: 为了抵御寒冷的秋风，会用小树枝和落叶当材料，做成蓑衣裹在身上。

description.en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.zh_cn: 为了抵御寒冷的秋风，会用小树枝和落叶当材料，做成蓑衣裹在身上。

description.en: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
description.zh_cn: 根据进化地点的不同，样子会发生变化。身边的材料会成为身体的一部分。

description.zh_cn: 根据进化地点的不同，样子会发生变化。身边的材料会成为身体的一部分。

description.en: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
description.zh_cn: 花苞沐浴阳光后，会绽开花瓣并活泼地动起来。

description.en: When it senses danger, it gushes a purple liquid. Some theories suggest this liquid is a greasy sweat induced by stress.
description.zh_cn: 如果感到危险，就会喷出紫色的汁。据说这是因紧张而产生的虚汗。

description.en: When it's attacked, it gushes a purple liquid that's not poisonous but makes Gastrodon's meat bitter and inedible.
description.zh_cn: 如果被袭击，就会喷出紫色的汁。虽然没有毒，但会让肉变苦，所以不能吃。

description.en: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
description.zh_cn: 作为驱动特殊马达的动力能源而被长期研究的宝可梦。

description.en: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
description.zh_cn: 据说栖息在位于这个世界背面的毁坏的世界里。那里所有的常规都与这个世界不同。

description.en: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
description.zh_cn: 拥有分解大气中的毒素，让荒芜大地瞬间变成花圃的力量。

description.en: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
description.zh_cn: 神奥神话里说，它从蛋中现身，并创造出了整个世界。

description.en: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.zh_cn: 雄性会摇晃头上的冠羽威吓对手。雌性的飞行能力在雄性之上。

description.en: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.
description.zh_cn: 无论是什么，都会用大颚吃掉。但野蛮鲈鱼本身也不过是更强大生物的食物罢了。

description.en: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
description.zh_cn: 如果在激烈的战斗中受伤，就会像岩石一样一动不动，沉思着磨炼自己的心智。

description.en: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
description.zh_cn: 不只是换季时，即使是气温和湿度的变化，身体颜色也会有稍稍改变。

description.en: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
description.zh_cn: 会用薄纱般的手脚缠住正在游泳的猎物，将其拖入深海之中。

description.en: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
description.zh_cn: 会缠着豪华客轮或是油轮周围，目的是将猎物拖进海里。

description.en: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
description.zh_cn: 下半身被云一样的能量体包裹着。以３００公里的时速在空中飞行。

description.en: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
description.zh_cn: 用尾巴上的尖刺射电攻击。在合众地区的天空飞来飞去制造雷电。

description.en: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."
description.zh_cn: 土地云造访的土地，作物收成必定大好，因此被称为农田之神。

description.en: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
description.zh_cn: 等待着用真实与理想填补自己失去的身体的英雄，是冰之传说的宝可梦。

description.en: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
description.zh_cn: 等待着用真实与理想填补自己失去的身体的英雄，是冰之传说的宝可梦。

description.en: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
description.zh_cn: 在江河湖海的水面奔跑，驰骋全世界。会出现在美丽的水边。

description.en: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
description.zh_cn: 美洛耶塔演奏的旋律拥有让周围的宝可梦或悲或喜的力量。

description.en: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
description.zh_cn: 被等离子队改造过的古代的虫宝可梦。背上的大炮力量得到了提升。

description.zh_cn: 世界上有着各种各样翅膀花纹的彩粉蝶。好像是受所居住土地的气候影响。

description.zh_cn: 如果危险逼近，就会竖起耳朵，释放出能拧碎１０吨重卡车的精神力量。

description.en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 曾跟随着历代国王。用灵力控制人和宝可梦的心，使之服从。

description.en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.zh_cn: 南瓜的身体里有无法往生的灵魂。黄昏到来便开始活动。

description.en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.zh_cn: 据说，能够分享出永恒的生命。以树木的样子睡了１０００年后复活。

description.en: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.
description.zh_cn: 它拿着的花，现在任何地方都没有在开放。而且被认为蕴藏着恐怖的力量。

description.en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description.zh_cn: 用扭曲空间的圆环把所有东西都击飞到远处的麻烦制造者。

description.en: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
description.zh_cn: 神话中的宝可梦，它用大雨和大海啸扩张海洋。曾与固拉多激烈交战。

description.en: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
description.zh_cn: 据说能用高温蒸发水分扩张大地。曾与盖欧卡激烈交战。

description.en: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.
description.zh_cn: 基格尔德的一部分聚集了十分之一左右。会扑到对手的怀里用锐利的牙齿咬住。

description.en: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.
description.zh_cn: 完整的基格尔德的样子。从胸部的嘴里放射出能摧毁一切的高能量。

description.en: It lifts its opponents' spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.
description.zh_cn: 用欢乐的舞蹈振奋敌人的心，趁其麻痹大意时发出电击让其触电。

description.en: It relaxes its opponents with its elegant dancing. When they let their guard down, it showers them with psychic energy.
description.zh_cn: 用优雅的舞蹈放松敌人的心，趁其麻痹大意时释放出精神力量。

description.en: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.
description.zh_cn: 用优美的舞蹈迷惑敌人的心，趁其麻痹大意时释放出招致死亡的诅咒。

description.en: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.
description.zh_cn: 对于不喜欢的命令会淡定地无视。为了解决对手，即使受伤了也完全不在意。

description.en: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."
description.zh_cn: 弱丁鱼们为了对抗敌人而组成了阵型。以被称之为海之魔物的力量而自豪。

description.en: Having been awakened successfully, it can change its type and battle—just like a certain Pokémon depicted in legends.
description.zh_cn: 已成功觉醒。能像传说的宝可梦一样改变自己的属性来战斗。
