description.en: It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it's crying inside.
description.zh_cn: 站在镜子前，拼命竖直折了的脖子。因为怎么都竖不直而在身体里哭泣。

description.en: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container—its artificial heart is the actual life-form.
description.zh_cn: 差不多５００年前的样子。那身体只是容器，人造的魂魄才是它的本体。

description.en: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.
description.zh_cn: 沐浴着夕阳而发生了特殊进化的鬃岩狼人。很安静，却蕴藏着强烈的斗志。

description.en: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.
description.zh_cn: 不断吞食索尔迦雷欧的光的样子。会扑向敌人，用背上和四肢的爪子将对手劈开。

description.en: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.
description.zh_cn: 露奈雅拉已经没有自我意识。它被奈克洛兹玛支配，不断释放出全部能量。

description.en: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.
description.zh_cn: 吸收压倒性的光能量后变化而成的样子。从全身发射出激光。

description.en: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
description.zh_cn: 随着成长，性格也会变得粗暴而有攻击性。因难以应付而丢弃它的训练家也不少。

description.en: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
description.zh_cn: 展开大片的花瓣沐浴阳光时，身体就会变得充满活力。

description.en: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
description.zh_cn: 从嘴里吐出灼热的火焰时，尾巴尖端就会燃起更加鲜红炽烈的火焰。

description.en: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
description.zh_cn: 从嘴里吐出灼热的火焰时，尾巴尖端就会燃起更加鲜红炽烈的火焰。

description.en: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
description.zh_cn: 身体很重，压住对手后就能让对手昏厥。遇到危险时会躲进壳里。

description.en: It sends out psychic power from the red organ on its forehead to foresee its opponents' every move.
description.zh_cn: 会从额头上的红色器官中放出精神力量，并看穿对手的一切。

description.en: It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!
description.zh_cn: 会夺取所有东西的生命。即便是作为主人的训练家，也是它想要施咒的目标。

description.en: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.
description.zh_cn: 沐浴惊人能量后的孩子得到了暂时性的成长。母亲却十分焦虑。

description.en: After Mega Evolution, it becomes able to fly. Perhaps because it's so happy, it rarely touches the ground.
description.zh_cn: 超级进化后变得可以飞行了。或许是因为太过高兴，它几乎不会降落到地面上。

description.en: Mega Evolution places a burden on its body. The stress causes it to become all the more ferocious.
description.zh_cn: 身体在超级进化时承受了很大的负担。会因压力而越发粗暴地横冲直撞。

description.en: It will attack anything that moves. Mega Evolution is a burden on its body, so it's incredibly irritated.
description.zh_cn: 会攻击所有会动的东西。超级进化对身体造成了负担，所以会非常的暴躁不安。

description.en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
description.zh_cn: 它是某位科学家长年累月持续进行可怕的遗传基因研究实验所诞生的成果。

description.en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
description.zh_cn: 它是某位科学家长年累月持续进行可怕的遗传基因研究实验所诞生的成果。

description.en: Excess energy from Mega Evolution stimulates its genes, and the wool it had lost grows in again.
description.zh_cn: 超级进化那过多的能量刺激了遗传基因。本应脱落的体毛也重新长了出来。

description.en: It stores the excess energy from Mega Evolution, so after a long time passes, its body starts to melt.
description.zh_cn: 由于体内存储了过多的超级进化能量，所以在经过很长一段时间后，它的身体就会开始熔化。

description.en: It can grip things with its two horns and lift 500 times its own body weight.
description.zh_cn: 会用２只角夹住并举起对方。甚至能举起比自己体重重５００倍的东西。

description.en: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.
description.zh_cn: 在黑鲁加自己都吃不消的高温下，红色爪子和尾巴前端已经开始熔化了。

description.en: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.
description.zh_cn: 后背由于体内注入了惊人的能量而裂开了。只剩下破坏的本能在驱使着它行动。

description.en: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
description.zh_cn: 有着能跃过３０层大楼的弹跳力。火焰拳能将对手烧成灰烬。

description.en: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
description.zh_cn: 如果是为了保护训练家，它就会用尽自己的精神力量制造出小型黑洞。

description.en: It has an extremely vicious disposition. It grips prey in its two sets of jaws and tears them apart with raw power.
description.zh_cn: 性格非常具有攻击性。会用２个颚夹住猎物，竭尽全力将对方撕碎。

description.en: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.
description.zh_cn: 会把一整座山都当做自己领地。伤痕越多的波士可多拉经历的战斗就越多，所以不能轻视。

description.en: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
description.zh_cn: 会用跳舞一般的优雅动作一边躲避攻击，一边向对手施展强烈的一击。

description.en: Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous amount of electricity, but it's too much for Manectric to fully control.
description.zh_cn: 因超级进化，体内储存了惊人的电量，但由于没有妥善运用而难以处理。

description.en: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.
description.zh_cn: 过大的能量增强了诅咒，无法压制。就连自己的训练家也会憎恨。

description.en: Normally, it dislikes fighting, so it really hates changing to this form for battles.
description.zh_cn: 因为原本就不喜欢斗争，所以非常讨厌为了战斗而变成这个样子。

description.en: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
description.zh_cn: 通过心灵感应交流情感。用能令光发生折射的羽毛包裹身体来让自己隐形。

description.en: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
description.zh_cn: 拥有很高智商的宝可梦。收起前肢飞行的话，速度能超越喷气式飞机。

description.en: Its arms and wings melted into something like scythes. Mad with rage, it rampages on and on.
description.zh_cn: 手臂和翅膀熔化，变成了镰刀状。会因发怒狂暴而到处大闹。

description.en: Its aura has expanded due to Mega Evolution. Governed only by its combative instincts, it strikes enemies without mercy.
description.zh_cn: 因超级进化，波导发生膨胀。会在斗争本能的驱使下，用无情的手段攻击敌人。

description.en: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."
description.zh_cn: 会引发暴风雪，让周围变得一片雪白。别名叫冰雪怪物。

description.en: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
description.zh_cn: 会用双手及尾部的３根毒针刺击、刺击、不断地刺击对手。

description.en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
description.zh_cn: 觅食的时候，会贴着水面飞掠而过，抓起鲤鱼王等猎物。

description.en: Tremendous energy strengthened the power of the Shellder on its tail, but it doesn't really affect Slowpoke.
description.zh_cn: 惊人的能量强化了尾巴上大舌贝的力量。对呆呆兽倒没什么影响。

description.en: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
description.zh_cn: 由地下高压和高热锻炼出来的身体比任何金属都要坚硬。

description.en: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
description.zh_cn: 手臂上长出的叶子锋利得连大树都能“唰”地一刀砍倒。在密林中战斗无人能敌。

description.en: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
description.zh_cn: 只要挥一挥如岩石般坚硬的手臂，就能将巨大的岩石打得粉碎。

description.en: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expands, rips through its skin, and falls out.
description.zh_cn: 胸口的宝石沐浴了超级进化的能量后膨胀起来，将皮肤撑裂，然后飞出。

description.en: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.
description.zh_cn: 黄色的花纹是以前的旧伤。超级进化的能量在里面游走，一阵一阵的疼痛，好像很痛苦。

description.en: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
description.zh_cn: 背上的驼峰火山每１０年就会进行一次大喷发，但暴怒时也会喷发。

description.en: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.
description.zh_cn: 会悠然地飞翔在天空之中。听见七夕青鸟优美的哼唱，就会让人心醉神迷，仿佛置身梦境。

description.en: When it spews stupendously cold air from its broken mouth, the entire area around it gets whited out.
description.zh_cn: 如果从破碎的嘴里吐出可怕的冷气，会让周围陷入一片白茫茫之中。

description.en: The stress of its two proud wings becoming misshapen and stuck together because of strong energy makes it go on a rampage.
description.zh_cn: 它那引以为傲的２根翅膀因强大的能量而扭曲着粘在一起，让它倍感压力，到处横冲直撞。

description.en: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.
description.zh_cn: 它的头脑变得更优秀了。其结果令战斗变得冷酷得惨不忍睹。

description.en: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
description.zh_cn: 因为栖息在高高的云层之上的臭氧层，所以从地面无法看见它的样子。

description.en: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.
description.zh_cn: 像鞭子一样挥动耳朵鞭打敌人。脾气暴躁又好战。

description.en: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
description.zh_cn: 因为有着能敏锐感知对手想法的能力，所以可以率先攻击。

description.en: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
description.zh_cn: 通过耳朵上的触角，能了解对方的身体状况，甚至连宝可梦何时从蛋里孵出来都能知道。

description.en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.zh_cn: 小碎钻的突变体。闪着粉红色光辉的身体被赞为全世界最美。

description.en: It shows no interest in anything that isn't fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.
description.zh_cn: 只对新鲜的东西感兴趣。如果带它去买东西，在挑选食材时会很有帮助。

description.en: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with so much food gathered by Rattata at its direction, it can't possibly eat it all.
description.zh_cn: 性格非常贪婪。巢穴里满是让小拉达们收集起来的，吃都吃不完的食物。

description.en: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."
description.zh_cn: 会骑上集中有精神力量的尾巴，像滑行一样移动。有着“陆地冲浪手”这一别名。

description.en: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.
description.zh_cn: 在逃离火山喷发的途中移居到了雪山上。冰甲壳硬如钢铁。

description.en: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.
description.zh_cn: 能在雪原上奔驰。为了将雪拨开，它的爪子长得又粗又尖，十分发达，

description.en: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.
description.zh_cn: 如果觉得可爱而随便靠近它的话，群体中的老大九尾就会出现，并把你冰封起来。

description.en: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.
description.zh_cn: 它之所以会将雪山中迷路的人们带到山脚下，是因为想快点赶走他们。

description.en: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.
description.zh_cn: 力量强大，即使是熔岩地质的地面也能飞快地挖掘前进。但它却很少现身。

description.en: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.
description.zh_cn: 金属材质的胡须很重，所以速度不怎么快，但有着能挖穿坚硬岩盘的力量。

description.en: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.
description.zh_cn: 浮躁、任性、耐不住性子。深受那些比起被别人照顾，更喜欢照顾别人的训练家欢迎。

description.en: In contrast to its lovely face, it's so brutal that it tortures its weakened prey rather than finishing them off.
description.zh_cn: 不同于其可爱的脸蛋，它有着玩弄衰弱的猎物而不杀死它们的残忍性格。

description.en: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.
description.zh_cn: 如果误以为是小石头而踩下去的话，它就会很生气并用头锤顶回来。被它撞到不单是痛，还会感觉麻麻的。

description.en: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."
description.zh_cn: 隆隆石之间互相争斗的话，它们周围就会出现闪光和爆炸声。当地人把这种现象称为陆地烟花。

description.en: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.
description.zh_cn: 个性顽固且难以相处。如果它不高兴了，就会全身放电，并以雷鸣般的声音吼叫。

description.en: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.
description.zh_cn: 在阿罗拉的垃圾处理场，大约栖息着１００只左右的臭泥。它们很能干，会吃掉很多垃圾。

description.en: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.
description.zh_cn: 体内的毒素有１００种以上。毒素和毒素之间的化学反应是其生命之源。

description.en: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.
description.zh_cn: 椰蛋树是阿罗拉人的骄傲。在历史悠久的绘画及建筑物上都刻有它的样子。

description.en: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.
description.zh_cn: 对于嘎啦嘎啦来说，绿意盎然的阿罗拉地区是一片残酷的土地。为了活下去，它会去操纵火焰。
